senses.def: not present in sth

ex.en: Love was totally absent from his childhood.
ex.cn: 他童年时没有得到丝毫关爱。

senses.def: showing that you are not really looking at or thinking about what is happening around you

ex.en: an absent expression
ex.cn: 心不在焉的神情

senses.def: to not go to or be in a place where you are expected to be

ex.en: He had absented himself from the office for the day.
ex.cn: 这一天他没有去办公室上班。

senses.def: a person who is not at a place where they were expected to be
a vote in an election that you can send when you cannot be present
the fact of being frequently away from work or school, especially without good reasons
a person who rents their property to sb, but does not live in it and rarely visits it
senses.chn: 在外业主，在外地主（不在产业内居住也很少过来）

senses.def: in a way that shows you are not looking at or thinking about what is happening around you

ex.en: He nodded absently, his attention absorbed by the screen.
ex.cn: 他全神注视着屏幕，心不在焉地点了点头。

senses.def: tending to forget things, perhaps because you are not thinking about what is around you, but about sth else
a very strong green alcoholic drink that tastes of aniseed
senses.chn: 苦艾酒（带茴香味的绿色烈性酒）

senses.def: total and complete

ex.en: a class for absolute beginners
ex.cn: 零起点班

ex.en: absolute confidence/trust/silence/truth
ex.cn: 充满信心；绝对信任；万籁俱寂；绝对真实

ex.en: 'You're wrong,' she said with absolute certainty.
ex.cn: “你错了。” 她斩钉截铁地说。

senses.def: used, especially in spoken English, to give emphasis to what you are saying
senses.chn: （口语中尤用以强调）道地的，确实的，十足的

ex.en: There's absolute rubbish on television tonight.
ex.cn: 今晚的电视节目简直糟糕透顶。

ex.en: He must earn an absolute fortune.
ex.cn: 他准是赚了一大笔钱。

senses.def: definite and without any doubt or confusion

ex.en: There was no absolute proof.
ex.cn: 没有确凿的证据。

ex.en: He taught us that the laws of physics were absolute.
ex.cn: 他教导我们说，物理定律是确实存在的。

senses.def: (of a legal decision) final

ex.en: The divorce became absolute last week.
ex.cn: 离婚在上周已成定局。

senses.def: not limited or restricted
senses.chn: 不受限制的；不受约束的

ex.en: absolute power/authority
ex.cn: 无上权力；绝对权威

ex.en: an absolute ruler/monarchy (= one with no limit to their power)
ex.cn: 独裁统治者；专制君主

senses.def: existing or measured independently and not in relation to sth else

ex.en: Although prices are falling in absolute terms, energy is still expensive.
ex.cn: 尽管能源的绝对售价在下降，但仍然昂贵。

ex.en: Beauty cannot be measured by any absolute standard.
ex.cn: 美是不可能用任何绝对标准来衡量的。

senses.def: an idea or a principle that is believed to be true or valid in any circumstances

ex.en: Right and wrong are, for her, moral absolutes.
ex.cn: 她认为，是与非是道德上的绝对准则。

senses.def: a form of ethanol that contains less than 1% water
senses.chn: 无水乙醇，无水酒精（含水量少于 1%）

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth is completely true
senses.chn: （强调真实无误）绝对地，完全地

ex.en: You're absolutely right.
ex.cn: 你完全正确。

ex.en: He made it absolutely clear.
ex.cn: 他把此事讲得一清二楚。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth negative

ex.en: She did absolutely no work.
ex.cn: 她一点活儿也没有干。

ex.en: There's absolutely nothing more the doctors can do.
ex.cn: 医生的确再也无计可施了。

senses.def: used with adjectives or verbs that express strong feelings or extreme qualities to mean 'extremely'

ex.en: I was absolutely furious with him.
ex.cn: 我被他气死了。

ex.en: She absolutely adores you.
ex.cn: 她极为崇拜你。

ex.en: He's an absolutely brilliant cook.
ex.cn: 他的厨艺精湛至极。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you agree with sb, or to give sb permission to do sth
senses.chn: （强调同意或允许）当然，对极了

ex.en: 'They could have told us, couldn't they?' 'Absolutely!'
ex.cn: “他们本来可以告诉我们的，不是吗？” “当然！”

ex.en: 'Can we leave a little early?' 'Absolutely!'
ex.cn: “我们可以早一点离开吗？” “完全可以！”

senses.def: used to emphasize that you strongly disagree with sb, or to refuse permission
senses.chn: （强调坚决不同意或不允许）当然不，绝对不行

ex.en: 'Was it any good?' 'No, absolutely not.'
ex.cn: “那有什么好处吗？” “绝对没有。”

senses.def: a measure of how bright a star, planet, etc. is, as it would be seen at a standard distance from the earth
senses.chn: 绝对星等（假定天体在距地球标准距离的地方所测得的亮度等级）

senses.def: more than half of the total number of votes or winning candidates
senses.chn: 绝对多数（指超过半数的选票或竞选席位）

senses.def: temperature measured from absolute zero in degrees kelvin
the lowest temperature that is thought to be possible
a formal statement that a person is forgiven for what he or she has done wrong
a political system in which a ruler or government has total power at all times
belief in a political, religious or moral principle which is thought to be true in all circumstances
senses.chn: （政治、宗教、道德上的）绝对主义，绝对论，绝对原则

senses.def: to state formally that sb is not guilty or responsible for sth

ex.en: The court absolved him of all responsibility for the accident.
ex.cn: 法院判定他对该事故不负任何责任。

senses.def: to give absolution to sb

ex.en: I absolve you from all your sins.
ex.cn: 我赦免你所有的罪过。

senses.def: to take in a liquid, gas or other substance from the surface or space around

ex.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
ex.cn: 植物吸收空气中的二氧化碳。

ex.en: The cream is easily absorbed into the skin.
ex.cn: 这种乳霜皮肤易吸收。

senses.def: to make sth smaller become part of sth larger

ex.en: The country simply cannot absorb this influx of refugees.
ex.cn: 这个国家实在没有能力接纳这么多涌入的难民。

ex.en: The surrounding small towns have been absorbed into the city.
ex.cn: 四周的小城镇已并入这座城市。

senses.def: to take sth into the mind and learn or understand it

ex.en: It's a lot of information to absorb all at once.
ex.cn: 要一下子消化这些资料，真是很多。

senses.def: to interest sb very much so that they pay no attention to anything else
senses.chn: 吸引全部注意力；使全神贯注

ex.en: This work had absorbed him for several years.
ex.cn: 这项工作曾使他沉迷了好几年。

senses.def: to take in and keep heat, light, energy, etc. instead of reflecting it

ex.en: Black walls absorb a lot of heat during the day.
ex.cn: 黑色墙壁在白天吸收大量的热。

senses.def: to reduce the effect of a blow, hit, etc.
senses.chn: 减轻（打击、碰击等的）作用

ex.en: This tennis racket absorbs shock on impact.
ex.cn: 这款网球拍能减轻撞击所产生的剧烈震动。

senses.def: to use up a large supply of sth, especially money or time
senses.chn: 耗费，耗去（大量金钱、时间等）

ex.en: The new proposals would absorb $80 billion of the federal budget.
ex.cn: 这些新提案将耗费 800 亿美元联邦政府预算。

senses.def: to deal with changes, effects, costs, etc.
senses.chn: 承受，承担，对付（变化、结果、费用等）

ex.en: The company is unable to absorb such huge losses.
ex.cn: 公司无法承受如此巨大的损失。

example.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
example.cn: 植物吸收空气中的二氧化碳。

example.en: The cream is easily absorbed into the skin.
example.cn: 这种乳霜皮肤易吸收。

senses.def: able to be absorbed, especially into the body
senses.chn: 可吸收的；（尤指）可被人体吸收的

ex.en: absorbable gases
ex.cn: 可吸收气体

senses.def: the ability of a substance to absorb light
very interested in sth/sb so that you are not paying attention to anything else
senses.chn: 被…吸引住；专心致志；全神贯注

ex.en: She seemed totally absorbed in her book.
ex.cn: 她好像完全沉浸在书中。

senses.def: able to take in sth easily, especially liquid

ex.en: absorbent paper/materials
ex.cn: 吸水纸；吸收性材料

senses.def: interesting and enjoyable and holding your attention completely
senses.chn: 十分吸引人的；引人入胜的；精彩的

ex.en: an absorbing book/game
ex.cn: 一本引人入胜的书；一个极有趣的游戏

ex.en: That's an interesting question, Daniel.
ex.cn: 那是个有趣的问题，丹尼尔。

ex.en: The exhibition tells the fascinating story of the steam age.
ex.cn: 展览讲述了蒸汽时代引人入胜的故事。

ex.en: Her latest book makes compelling reading.
ex.cn: 她新出的书读起来扣人心弦。

ex.en: Thank you for a most stimulating discussion.
ex.cn: 感谢你们妙趣横生的讨论。

ex.en: His books are always so gripping.
ex.cn: 他的书总是那么扣人心弦。

senses.def: the process of a liquid, gas or other substance being taken in

ex.en: Vitamin D is necessary to aid the absorption of calcium from food.
ex.cn: 从食物中吸取钙需靠维生素 D 的帮助。

senses.def: the process of a smaller group, country, etc. becoming part of a larger group or country

ex.en: the absorption of immigrants into the host country
ex.cn: 移民融入移民国

senses.def: the fact of sb being very interested in sth so that it takes all their attention
senses.chn: 专心致志；全神贯注；着迷

ex.en: His work suffered because of his total absorption in sport.
ex.cn: 他痴迷于体育运动而影响了工作。

senses.def: to choose not to use a vote, either in favour of or against sth

ex.en: Ten people voted in favour, five against and two abstained.
ex.cn: 十人投票赞成，五人反对，两人弃权。

senses.def: to decide not to do or have sth, especially sth you like or enjoy, because it is bad for your health or considered morally wrong

ex.en: to abstain from alcohol/sex/drugs
ex.cn: 戒酒；禁欲；戒毒

senses.def: to stay away from sth

ex.en: The workers who abstained from work yesterday have been suspended.
ex.cn: 昨天旷工的工人被暂时停职。

senses.def: a person who chooses not to vote either in favour of or against sth
a person who never drinks alcohol
not allowing yourself to have much food or alcohol, or to do things that are enjoyable
an act of choosing not to use a vote either in favour of or against sth

ex.en: The voting was 15 in favour, 3 against and 2 abstentions.
ex.cn: 表决结果是 15 人赞成，3 人反对，2 人弃权。

senses.def: the act of not allowing yourself to have or do sth enjoyable or sth that is considered bad
the practice of not allowing yourself sth, especially food, alcoholic drinks or sex, for moral, religious or health reasons
senses.chn: （因道德、宗教或健康原因对饮食、酒、色等的）节制；禁欲

ex.en: total abstinence from strong drink
ex.cn: 戒绝烈性酒

senses.def: not allowing yourself sth, especially alcoholic drinks, for moral, religious or health reasons
senses.chn: （因道德、宗教或健康原因对酒等）节制的；禁欲的

senses.def: based on general ideas and not on any particular real person, thing or situation
senses.chn: 抽象的（与个别情况相对）；纯理论的

ex.en: abstract knowledge/principles
ex.cn: 理论知识；抽象原理

ex.en: The research shows that pre-school children are capable of thinking in abstract terms.
ex.cn: 研究显示，学前儿童具有抽象思维的能力。

senses.def: existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical reality
senses.chn: 抽象的（与具体经验相对）

ex.en: We may talk of beautiful things but beauty itself is abstract.
ex.cn: 我们尽可谈论美的事物，但美本身却是抽象的。

senses.def: not representing people or things in a realistic way, but expressing the artist's ideas about them
an abstract work of art
a short piece of writing containing the main ideas in a document
in a general way, without referring to a particular real person, thing or situation
to remove sth from somewhere
senses.chn: 把…抽象出；提取；抽取；分离

ex.en: She abstracted the main points from the argument.
ex.cn: 她提炼出论证的要点。

ex.en: a plan to abstract 8 million gallons of water from the river
ex.cn: 从这条河中抽取 800 万加仑水的计划

senses.def: to make a written summary of a book, etc.
thinking deeply about sth and not paying attention to what is around you
a style and movement in abstract art that developed in New York in the middle of the 20th century and tries to express the feelings of the artist rather than showing a physical object
senses.chn: 抽象表现主义（20 世纪中期源于纽约，旨在表现艺术家之情感而非现实形体）

senses.def: a general idea not based on any particular real person, thing or situation; the quality of being abstract
the state of thinking deeply about sth and not paying attention to what is around you
the action of removing sth from sth else; the process of being removed from sth else

ex.en: water abstraction from rivers
ex.cn: 从河流中抽取水

senses.def: the principles and practices of abstract art
the expression of ideas in an abstract way
senses.chn: （思想的）抽象表达；抽象主义创作

senses.def: a noun, for example goodness or freedom, that refers to an idea or a general quality, not to a physical object
difficult to understand

ex.en: an abstruse argument
ex.cn: 玄奥的论点

senses.def: completely ridiculous; not logical and sensible
senses.chn: 荒谬的；荒唐的；怪诞不经的

ex.en: That uniform makes the guards look absurd.
ex.cn: 警卫们穿着那种制服看起来怪模怪样的。

ex.en: Of course it's not true, what an absurd idea.
ex.cn: 那当然不合乎事实，这个想法太荒唐了！

senses.def: things that are or that seem to be absurd
senses.chn: 荒诞的事物；悖理的东西

ex.en: He has a good sense of the absurd.
ex.cn: 他对荒诞事物有较强的识别能力。

senses.def: the belief that humans exist in a world with no purpose or order
senses.chn: 荒诞主义（认为人存在于无序宇宙之中）

a bull in a china shop.lemma: a bull in a china shop

senses.def: a person who is careless, or who moves or acts in a rough or awkward way, in a place or situation where skill and care are needed
senses.chn: （不顾环境）笨拙莽撞的人，冒失鬼

senses.def: a large quantity that is more than enough
in large quantities

ex.en: Fruit and vegetables grew in abundance on the island.
ex.cn: 该岛盛产水果和蔬菜。

senses.def: existing in large quantities; more than enough

ex.en: Fish are abundant in the lake.
ex.cn: 湖里鱼很多。

ex.en: We have abundant evidence to prove his guilt.
ex.cn: 我们有充分的证据证明他有罪。

senses.def: very clear

ex.en: She made her wishes abundantly clear.
ex.cn: 她充分表明了她的意愿。

senses.def: in large quantities

ex.en: Calcium is found most abundantly in milk.
ex.cn: 奶含钙最丰富。

senses.def: the use of sth in a way that is wrong or harmful

ex.en: alcohol/drug/solvent abuse
ex.cn: 酗酒；嗜毒；溶媒滥用

ex.en: The system of paying cash bonuses is open to abuse (= might be used in the wrong way).
ex.cn: 支付现金红利制度可能被人钻空子。

ex.en: He was arrested on charges of corruption and abuse of power.
ex.cn: 他因被控贪污腐化和滥用职权而遭逮捕。

ex.en: What she did was an abuse of her position as manager.
ex.cn: 她的所作所为是滥用经理职权。

senses.def: unfair, cruel or violent treatment of sb

ex.en: child abuse
ex.cn: 虐待儿童

ex.en: sexual abuse
ex.cn: 性虐待

ex.en: reported abuses by the secret police
ex.cn: 已举报的秘密警察虐待行为

ex.en: She suffered years of physical abuse.
ex.cn: 她遭受了多年的肉体摧残。

senses.def: rude and offensive remarks, usually made when sb is very angry

ex.en: to scream/hurl/shout abuse
ex.cn: 高声谩骂；破口大骂；大声辱骂

ex.en: a stream/torrent of abuse
ex.cn: 不断辱骂；劈头盖脸一通臭骂

senses.def: to make bad use of sth, or to use so much of sth that it harms your health

ex.en: to abuse alcohol/drugs
ex.cn: 酗酒；嗜毒

ex.en: He systematically abused his body with heroin and cocaine.
ex.cn: 他因吸食海洛因和可卡因一步一步地把身体搞垮了。

senses.def: to use power or knowledge unfairly or wrongly
senses.chn: 滥用，妄用（权力、所知所闻）

ex.en: She abused her position as principal by giving jobs to her friends.
ex.cn: 她滥用自己作为校长的职权，把工作安排给朋友们。

ex.en: He felt they had abused his trust by talking about him to the press (= tricked him, although he had trusted them).
ex.cn: 他觉得他们向新闻界透露有关他的情况是辜负了他的信任。

senses.def: to treat a person or an animal in a cruel or violent way, especially sexually

ex.en: All the children had been physically and emotionally abused.
ex.cn: 所有这些儿童的身心都受到了摧残。

ex.en: He had abused his own daughter.
ex.cn: 他曾奸污了自己的亲生女儿。

ex.en: The boy had been sexually abused.
ex.cn: 这个男孩曾遭受过性虐待。

senses.def: to make rude or offensive remarks to or about sb

ex.en: The referee had been threatened and abused.
ex.cn: 裁判遭到了恐吓和谩骂。

example.en: He was arrested on charges of corruption and abuse of power.
example.cn: 他因被控贪污腐化和滥用职权而遭逮捕。

senses.def: rude and offensive; criticizing rudely and unfairly

ex.en: abusive language/remarks
ex.cn: 秽言恶语；恶言谩骂

ex.en: He became abusive when he was drunk.
ex.cn: 他喝醉时就满口脏话骂人了。

senses.def: involving violence

ex.en: an abusive relationship
ex.cn: 虐待关系

senses.def: to be next to sth or to have one side touching the side of sth

ex.en: His land abuts onto a road.
ex.cn: 他的土地紧靠公路。

senses.def: a situation in which there is a lot of a particular item for sale, so that prices are low and people buying have a choice
extremely bad or of a very low standard
a very deep wide space or hole that seems to have no bottom

ex.en: Ahead of them was a gaping abyss.
ex.cn: 他们前面是一个巨大的深渊。

ex.en: an abyss of ignorance/despair/loneliness
ex.cn: 无知到极点；彻底绝望；无尽的孤寂

ex.en: The country is stepping back from the edge of an abyss.
ex.cn: 该国临渊而退。

senses.def: relating to the bottom of the ocean, especially to depths of between 3 000 and 6 000 metres
senses.chn: 深海的，深渊的（大洋底部，尤指深度达 3 000-6 000 米间的）

senses.def: air conditioning
alternating current
a tree with yellow or white flowers. There are several types of acacia tree, some of which produce a sticky liquid used in making glue.
senses.chn: 金合欢树（有些种类的树汁用于制作黏胶）

senses.def: the world of learning, teaching, research, etc. at universities, and the people involved in it
connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities
senses.chn: 学业的，教学的，学术的（尤指与学校教育有关）

ex.en: The students return in October for the start of the new academic year.
ex.cn: 学生于十月返校，开始新学年的学习。

ex.en: high/low academic standards
ex.cn: 高／低学术水平

ex.en: an academic career
ex.cn: 学术生涯

senses.def: involving a lot of reading and studying rather than practical or technical skills
senses.chn: 学术性的（与实践性、技术性相对）

ex.en: academic subjects/qualifications
ex.cn: 学科；学术资历

senses.def: good at subjects involving a lot of reading and studying

ex.en: She wasn't very academic and hated school.
ex.cn: 她学习不怎么样，而且讨厌上学。

senses.def: not connected to a real or practical situation and therefore not important
senses.chn: 纯理论的；空谈的；学究式的

ex.en: It is a purely academic question.
ex.cn: 这是一个纯理论问题。

ex.en: The whole thing's academic now—we can't win anyway.
ex.cn: 现在这一切都是纸上谈兵，反正我们赢不了。

senses.def: a person who teaches and/or does research at a university or college
senses.chn: 高等院校教师；高校科研人员

senses.def: a member of an academy (2)
the period of the year during which students go to school or university
a school or college for special training

ex.en: the Royal Academy of Music
ex.cn: 皇家音乐学院

ex.en: a police/military academy
ex.cn: 警官／军官学校

senses.def: a type of official organization which aims to encourage and develop art, literature, science, etc.
senses.chn: （艺术、文学、科学等的）研究院，学会

ex.en: the Royal Academy of Arts
ex.cn: 皇家艺术学会

senses.def: a secondary school in Scotland
a private school in the US
a secondary school in England which has a great deal of independence from local authority control
senses.chn: （英格兰不受地方政府直接管辖的）国立中等学校，国立中学

senses.def: a French-speaking Canadian from New Brunswick, and parts of Quebec near it, Nova Scotia or Prince Edward Island
senses.chn: 阿卡迪亚人（操法语，居于加拿大新不伦瑞克省、邻近的魁北克省部分地区、新斯科舍省或爱德华王子岛省）

senses.def: (in the US) a person from Louisiana whose family originally came from the French colony of Acadia in what is now Nova Scotia
senses.chn: （美国路易斯安那州的）阿卡迪亚法国殖民地移民后裔

senses.def: if you open up a can of worms, you start doing sth that will cause a lot of problems and be very difficult
senses.chn: 棘手的问题；难题；麻烦事

senses.def: for singing voices alone, without musical instruments
(in Britain) Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service (the organization that helps employers and employees settle disagreements)

senses.chn: 不能工作；失去作用；停止运转

ex.en: Jon will be out of action for weeks with a broken leg.
ex.cn: 乔恩断了一条腿，将有几个星期不能工作。

ex.en: The photocopier is out of action today.
ex.cn: 复印机今天出故障了。

senses.def: a share or role in an interesting or exciting activity, especially in order to make money
senses.chn: 插手，参与（尤指为了赚钱）

ex.en: Foreign firms will all want a piece of the action if the new airport goes ahead.
ex.cn: 要是新机场开始修建，外国公司都会来插一手捞好处。

senses.def: to act in order to avoid danger or an unpleasant situation
senses.chn: 采取回避行动（以避免危险或不愉快的处境）

senses.def: to suddenly start working or doing sth

ex.en: 'Let's go!' he said, springing into action.
ex.cn: 他突然行动起来，说道：“咱们走！”

ex.en: The town springs into life (= becomes busy) during the carnival.
ex.cn: 狂欢节期间，全城突然热闹起来。

senses.def: to start doing sth quickly and with a lot of energy
senses.chn: 立即行动起来；马上大干起来

senses.def: to make sure that sth is done or dealt with

ex.en: Your request will be actioned.
ex.cn: 你的要求会处理的。

senses.def: giving sb a valid reason to bring a case to court
senses.chn: 可予起诉的；可提起诉讼的

senses.def: that can be done or acted on

ex.en: The research is aimed at getting actionable solutions.
ex.cn: 这项研究旨在寻求可行的解决方案。

senses.def: a doll representing a soldier or a character from a film/movie, TV show, etc.
senses.chn: （仿影视等角色的）战士玩偶，人偶

senses.def: a group that is formed to work for social or political change
senses.chn: （社会或政治改革的）行动小组

ex.en: the Child Poverty Action Group
ex.cn: 解除儿童贫困行动小组

senses.def: a film/movie that has a lot of exciting action and adventure
full of exciting events and activity
senses.chn: 充满令人兴奋的活动的

ex.en: an action-packed weekend
ex.cn: 活动安排得满满的周末

senses.def: a suggestion for action that must be taken, especially one that is made in a meeting
senses.chn: （尤指在会议上达成的）行动方案

senses.def: part of sth, for example a sports game on television, that is immediately repeated, often more slowly, so that you can see a goal or another exciting or important moment again
senses.chn: （体育比赛等电视画面的）即时重放，慢镜头重放

senses.def: an event or a situation that repeats sth that has happened before

ex.en: It was an action replay of the problems of his first marriage.
ex.cn: 这是他第一次婚姻问题的重演。

senses.def: studies done to improve the working methods of people who do a particular job or activity, especially in education
senses.chn: （尤指教育界为改进工作方法等而开展的）行动研究（法）

senses.def: what a person actually does means more than what they say they will do
the positions to which soldiers go to be ready for fighting
to make sth such as a device or chemical process start working

ex.en: The burglar alarm is activated by movement.
ex.cn: 这防盗警报器一动就会响。

ex.en: The gene is activated by a specific protein.
ex.cn: 这种基因由一种特异性蛋白激活。

senses.def: always busy doing things, especially physical activities

ex.en: Although he's nearly 80, he is still very active.
ex.cn: 尽管快 80 岁了，他还是十分活跃。

senses.def: involved in sth; making a determined effort and not leaving sth to happen by itself

ex.en: They were both politically active.
ex.cn: 他们两人在政治上都很积极。

ex.en: active involvement/participation/support/resistance
ex.cn: 积极参与／参加／支持／抵抗

ex.en: She takes an active part in school life.
ex.cn: 她积极参加学校活动。

ex.en: The parents were active in campaigning against cuts to the education budget.
ex.cn: 学生家长积极参加反对削减教育预算的活动。

ex.en: They took active steps to prevent the spread of the disease.
ex.cn: 他们采取积极措施，防止疾病蔓延。

senses.def: doing sth regularly; functioning

ex.en: sexually active teenagers
ex.cn: 有性生活的青少年

ex.en: animals that are active only at night
ex.cn: 仅在夜间活动的动物

ex.en: The virus is still active in the blood.
ex.cn: 这种病毒仍然在血液中起作用。

ex.en: an active volcano (= likely to erupt )
ex.cn: 活火山

senses.def: lively and full of ideas
senses.chn: 活跃的；（思想上）充满活力的

ex.en: That child has a very active imagination.
ex.cn: 那个小孩想象力十分丰富。

senses.def: having or causing a chemical effect

ex.en: What is the active ingredient in aspirin?
ex.cn: 什么是阿司匹林中的有效成分？

senses.def: connected with a verb whose subject is the person or thing that performs the action

ex.en: In 'He was driving the car', the verb is active.
ex.cn: 在 He was driving the car 一句中，动词是主动语态。

senses.def: the form of a verb in which the subject is the person or thing that performs the action
a person who is actively involved in trying to improve things in their local community
senses.chn: 社区活动积极分子（积极参与社区事务以改善区内环境）

senses.def: a list of people that an organization may contact at any time, offering a service, providing information, or asking them to do sth
senses.chn: 积极分子名单（可用于随时联系以便提供服务、信息或寻求帮助等）

ex.en: Please email us to be removed from our active list of blood donors.
ex.cn: 假如你想把自己的名字从献血积极分子名单中删去，请给我们发电子邮件。

senses.def: a list of officers or former officers connected to one of the armed forces who can be called for duty
senses.chn: 服役名册（记录现役或退役军官）

senses.def: the work of a member of the armed forces, especially during a war

ex.en: troops on active service
ex.cn: 现役部队

senses.def: a person who works to achieve political or social change, especially as a member of an organization with particular aims

ex.en: gay activists
ex.cn: 争取男同性恋者权益的活动人士

senses.def: a situation in which sth is happening or a lot of things are being done

ex.en: economic activity
ex.cn: 经济活动

ex.en: The streets were noisy and full of activity.
ex.cn: 街上熙熙攘攘，车水马龙。

ex.en: Muscles contract and relax during physical activity.
ex.cn: 身体活动时肌肉收缩放松。

senses.def: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure, or in order to achieve a particular aim
senses.chn: （为兴趣、娱乐或达到一定目的而进行的）活动

ex.en: leisure/outdoor/classroom activities
ex.cn: 休闲／户外／课堂活动

ex.en: The club provides a wide variety of activities including tennis, swimming and squash.
ex.cn: 这家俱乐部的活动丰富多彩，诸如网球、游泳、壁球等。

ex.en: illegal/criminal activities
ex.cn: 不法／犯罪活动

senses.def: an event caused by natural forces beyond human control, such as a storm, a flood or an earthquake
senses.chn: 天灾；不可抗力（如风暴、洪水、地震）

senses.def: a person who performs on the stage, on television or in films/movies, especially as a profession
an actor who is in charge of a theatre company and acts in the plays that they perform
a woman who performs on the stage, on television or in films/movies, especially as a profession

ex.en: My daughter prefers to see a woman doctor.
ex.cn: 我的女儿喜欢让女医生看病。

ex.en: They have a male nanny for their kids.
ex.cn: 他们有个男保姆照料孩子。

ex.en: a female racing driver
ex.cn: 女赛车手

ex.en: Everyone needs to feel he is loved.
ex.cn: 人人都需要有被爱的感觉。

ex.en: Does everybody know what they want?
ex.cn: 人人都知道自己需要什么吗？

ex.en: Somebody's left their coat here.
ex.cn: 有人把外衣落在这儿了。

senses.def: used to emphasize sth that is real or exists in fact

ex.en: What were his actual words?
ex.cn: 他的原话是什么？

ex.en: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
ex.cn: 实际成本比我们预计的要高。

ex.en: James looks younger than his wife but in actual fact (= really) he is five years older.
ex.cn: 詹姆斯看起来比他妻子年轻，但实际上他还大了五岁。

ex.en: I need the actual figures, not an estimate.
ex.cn: 我需要确切的数字，而不是估计。

ex.en: How long have you been in your present job?
ex.cn: 你干现在这工作多长时间了？

ex.en: The factory cannot continue its current level of production.
ex.cn: 这家工厂不能维持目前的生产水平。

senses.def: used to emphasize the most important part of sth
senses.chn: （强调事情最重要的部分）真正的，…本身

ex.en: The wedding preparations take weeks but the actual ceremony takes less than an hour.
ex.cn: 准备婚礼要几周，而婚礼仪式本身还不到一小时。

senses.def: the crime of causing sb physical injury
the state of sth existing in reality

ex.en: The building looked as impressive in actuality as it did in photographs.
ex.cn: 这栋大楼外观雄伟，与照片中所见一模一样。

senses.def: things that exist
senses.chn: 真实情况；现实情况；事实

ex.en: the grim actualities of prison life
ex.cn: 严酷的监狱生活现实

senses.def: to make sth real; to make sth happen

ex.en: He finally actualized his dream.
ex.cn: 他最终实现了自己的梦想。

senses.def: used in speaking to emphasize a fact or a comment, or that sth is really true
senses.chn: （在口语中用于强调事实）的确，真实地，事实上

ex.en: What did she actually say?
ex.cn: 她到底是怎么说的？

ex.en: It's not actually raining now.
ex.cn: 其实现在并没有下雨。

ex.en: That's the only reason I'm actually going.
ex.cn: 那是我确实要走的唯一理由。

ex.en: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.
ex.cn: 那里有很多人可以真正帮上你的忙。

ex.en: I didn't want to say anything without actually reading the letter first.
ex.cn: 在没有确确实实看过那封信之前我什么也不想说。

senses.def: used to show a contrast between what is true and what sb believes, and to show surprise about this contrast
senses.chn: （表示想法与事实不一致因而惊奇）居然，竟然

ex.en: It was actually quite fun after all.
ex.cn: 这居然还很有趣。

ex.en: The food was not actually all that expensive.
ex.cn: 食物居然并不那么昂贵。

ex.en: Our turnover actually increased last year.
ex.cn: 去年我们的营业额竟然增加了。

senses.def: used to correct sb in a polite way
senses.chn: （礼貌地纠正他人）实际上，事实上

ex.en: We're not American, actually. We're Canadian.
ex.cn: 实际上我们不是美国人。我们是加拿大人。

ex.en: Actually, it would be much more sensible to do it later.
ex.cn: 事实上，以后再办这件事可能要明智得多。

ex.en: They're not married, actually.
ex.cn: 他们实际上没有结婚。

senses.def: used to get sb's attention, to introduce a new topic or to say sth that sb may not like, in a polite way
senses.chn: （礼貌地引起注意、转换话题、直言）确实，说实在的

ex.en: Actually, I'll be a bit late home.
ex.cn: 说真的，我回家会晚一点。

ex.en: Actually, I'm busy at the moment—can I call you back?
ex.cn: 说实在的，我这会儿正忙。我可以给你回电话吗？

ex.en: I need the actual figures, not an estimate.
ex.cn: 我需要确切的数字，而不是估计。

ex.en: How long have you been in your present job?
ex.cn: 你干现在这工作多长时间了？

ex.en: The factory cannot continue its current level of production.
ex.cn: 这家工厂不能维持目前的生产水平。

senses.def: a person whose job involves calculating insurance risks and payments for insurance companies by studying how frequently accidents, fires, deaths, etc. happen
senses.chn: 精算师（研究事故、火灾、死亡等发生的频率，为保险公司计算保险风险和保险费）

senses.def: to make a machine or device start to work
to make sb behave in a particular way

ex.en: He was actuated entirely by malice.
ex.cn: 他完全是出于恶意。

senses.def: to behave badly

ex.en: The kids started acting up.
ex.cn: 孩子们开始调皮捣蛋起来。

senses.def: to not work as it should

ex.en: How long has your ankle been acting up?
ex.cn: 你的脚踝受伤多久了？

senses.def: the ability to think, see or hear clearly
the ability to understand and decide things quickly and well

ex.en: business/commercial/financial acumen
ex.cn: 生意上／商业上／理财上精明强干

senses.def: a form of medical treatment, originally from East Asia, in which pressure is applied to particular parts of the body using the fingers
senses.chn: 指针疗法（一种治疗方式，以手指按压身体特定部位）

senses.def: a Chinese method of treating pain and illness using special thin needles which are pushed into the skin in particular parts of the body
a person who is trained to perform acupuncture
an easy job; a pleasant situation that other people would like
senses.chn: 轻松的工作；美差；令人羡慕的轻松状态

senses.def: very serious or severe

ex.en: There is an acute shortage of water.
ex.cn: 水严重短缺。

ex.en: acute pain
ex.cn: 剧痛

ex.en: the world's acute environmental problems
ex.cn: 全球十分严重的环境问题

ex.en: Competition for jobs is acute.
ex.cn: 求职竞争非常激烈。

senses.def: an acute illness is one that has quickly become severe and dangerous

ex.en: acute appendicitis
ex.cn: 急性阑尾炎

senses.def: very sensitive and well developed

ex.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
ex.cn: 狗的嗅觉灵敏。

senses.def: intelligent and quick to notice and understand things

ex.en: He is an acute observer of the social scene.
ex.cn: 他是个敏锐的社会现状观察者。

ex.en: Her judgement is acute.
ex.cn: 她的判断敏锐。

senses.def: less than 90°
the mark placed over a vowel to show how it should be pronounced, as over the e in fiancé
senses.chn: 尖音符号（标在元音上面）

senses.def: an angle of less than 90°
noticing or feeling sth very strongly
senses.chn: 深深感觉到；强烈意识到

ex.en: I am acutely aware of the difficulties we face.
ex.cn: 我十分清楚我们面临的困难。

senses.def: (describing unpleasant feelings) very; very strongly
senses.chn: （描述不快的感觉）极其，强烈地

ex.en: acutely embarrassed
ex.cn: 极其尴尬

senses.def: to a severe and dangerous degree

ex.en: acutely ill
ex.cn: 病重

senses.def: not occurring in cycles
containing no rings of atoms
a drug that is used to treat viruses
senses.chn: 阿昔洛韦（用于抗病毒的药）

senses.def: used in the Christian calendar to show a particular number of years since the year when Christ was believed to have been born (from Latin 'Anno Domini')
senses.chn: 公元（源自拉丁语 Anno Domini）

ex.en: in (the year) AD 55
ex.cn: 公元 55 年

ex.en: in 55 AD
ex.cn: 公元 55 年

ex.en: in the fifth century AD
ex.cn: 公元 5 世纪

senses.def: a well-known phrase expressing a general truth about people or the world
a piece of music to be played slowly
to not know at all who sb is
senses.chn: 根本不认识某人；与某人素不相识

senses.def: determined not to change your mind or to be persuaded about sth

ex.en: Eva was adamant that she would not come.
ex.cn: 伊娃坚决不来。

senses.def: very strong and impossible to break
an event that is disappointing because it is not as exciting or impressive as expected
senses.chn: 哑炮；令人失望的事；令人扫兴的事

senses.def: the lump at the front of the throat that sticks out, particularly in men, and moves up and down when you swallow
a woman who needs help
senses.chn: 落难女子；需要帮助的女子

senses.def: to change sth in order to make it suitable for a new use or situation
senses.chn: 使适应，使适合（新用途、新情况）

ex.en: These styles can be adapted to suit individual tastes.
ex.cn: 这些式样可以修改，以适应个人不同爱好。

ex.en: Most of these tools have been specially adapted for use by disabled people.
ex.cn: 这些工具多数已经过特别改装，供残疾人使用。

senses.def: to change your behaviour in order to deal more successfully with a new situation

ex.en: It's amazing how soon you adapt.
ex.cn: 你这么快就适应了，真是令人惊奇。

ex.en: The organisms were forced to adapt in order to survive.
ex.cn: 生物被迫适应，以求生存。

ex.en: We have had to adapt quickly to the new system.
ex.cn: 我们不得不迅速适应了新制度。

ex.en: A large organization can be slow to adapt to change.
ex.cn: 大机构可能应变迟缓。

ex.en: It took him a while to adapt himself to his new surroundings.
ex.cn: 他过了好一阵子才适应了新环境。

senses.def: to change a book or play so that it can be made into a play, film/movie, television programme, etc.

ex.en: Three of her novels have been adapted for television.
ex.cn: 她的长篇小说中有三部已改编成电视节目。

example.en: These styles can be adapted to suit individual tastes.
example.cn: 这些式样可以修改，以适应个人不同爱好。

example.en: Most of these tools have been specially adapted for use by disabled people.
example.cn: 这些工具多数已经过特别改装，供残疾人使用。

example.en: We have had to adapt quickly to the new system.
example.cn: 我们不得不迅速适应了新制度。

example.en: It took him a while to adapt himself to his new surroundings.
example.cn: 他过了好一阵子才适应了新环境。

senses.def: able to change or be changed in order to deal successfully with new situations
senses.chn: 有适应能力的；能适应的

ex.en: Older workers can be as adaptable and quick to learn as anyone else.
ex.cn: 较年长的工人的适应能力和学习速度有时并不亚于其他任何人。

ex.en: Successful businesses are highly adaptable to economic change.
ex.cn: 成功的企业对于经济变化的适应能力很强。

senses.def: a film/movie, book or play that is based on a particular piece of work but that has been changed for a new situation

ex.en: a screen adaptation of Shakespeare's 'Macbeth'
ex.cn: 莎士比亚悲剧《麦克白》的电影改写本

senses.def: the process of changing sth, for example your behaviour, to suit a new situation

ex.en: the adaptation of desert species to the hot conditions
ex.cn: 沙漠物种对炎热环境的适应

senses.def: concerned with changing; able to change when necessary in order to deal with different situations

ex.en: Adaptive learning systems offer students customized learning experiences according to their needs and capabilities.
ex.cn: 适应性学习系统根据学生的需要和能力为他们提供个性化的学习体验。

senses.def: a device for connecting pieces of electrical equipment that were not designed to fit together
a device for connecting more than one piece of equipment to the same socket (= a place in the wall where equipment is connected to the electricity supply)
senses.chn: （供多个设备连接电源的）多头插座，多功能插座

senses.def: a person who does not tell other people much about their life, and who surprises other people by having interesting qualities
a person taking part in a race, etc. who surprises everyone by winning
senses.chn: 出人意料的获胜者；黑马

senses.def: the time when sb will have to deal with the result of sth that they have done wrong, or be punished for sth bad that they have done
senses.chn: 遭报应的日子；受到惩罚的日子

senses.def: aide-de-camp
to put sth together with sth else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.

ex.en: Next add the flour.
ex.cn: 接着加面粉。

ex.en: The juice contains no added sugar.
ex.cn: 这种果汁没有加糖。

ex.en: The plan has the added (= extra) advantage of bringing employment to rural areas.
ex.cn: 该计划还有一个优点，就是给农村地区带来了就业机会。

ex.en: A new wing was added to the building.
ex.cn: 这栋大楼新添了一座配楼。

ex.en: Shall I add your name to the list?
ex.cn: 我可以把你的名字写进名单吗？

senses.def: to put numbers or amounts together to get a total

ex.en: Add 9 to the total.
ex.cn: 总数再加上 9。

ex.en: If you add all these amounts together you get a huge figure.
ex.cn: 你把这些数目加在一起就会得到一个巨额数字。

senses.def: to say sth more; to make a further remark

ex.en: 'And don't be late,' she added.
ex.cn: “还有别迟到。” 她补充说道。

ex.en: I have nothing to add to my earlier statement.
ex.cn: 我对我早先说的话没有什么补充的。

ex.en: He added that they would return a week later.
ex.cn: 他接着说，他们一周以后会回来。

senses.def: to give a particular quality to an event, a situation, etc.

ex.en: The suite will add a touch of class to your bedroom.
ex.cn: 这套家具会给你的卧室增添一些典雅气质。

senses.def: to make a bad relationship with sb worse by offending them even more
senses.chn: 伤害之余又侮辱；（冒犯别人）令关系恶化

senses.def: used to introduce another fact that helps to emphasize a point you have already made

ex.en: Add to this the excellent service and you can see why it's the most popular hotel on the island.
ex.cn: 这再加上优质服务，你就能明白为何这家旅馆在岛上最受欢迎。

senses.def: to include sth with sth else

ex.en: Remember to add in the cost of drinks.
ex.cn: 记住把饮料费加进去。

senses.def: to include or attach sth extra

ex.en: A service charge of 15% was added on to the bill.
ex.cn: 账单上附加了 15% 的服务费。

senses.def: to increase sth in size, number, amount, etc.
senses.chn: 使（数量）增加；使（规模）扩大

ex.en: The bad weather only added to our difficulties.
ex.cn: 恶劣的天气更增加了我们的困难。

ex.en: The house has been added to (= new rooms, etc. have been built on to it) from time to time.
ex.cn: 这座房子一次又一次地扩建。

senses.def: to seem reasonable; to make sense

ex.en: His story just doesn't add up.
ex.cn: 他说的情况根本不合情理。

senses.def: to increase by small amounts until there is a large total

senses.def: a small earthquake that happens after a bigger one
a taste (usually an unpleasant one) that stays in your mouth after you have eaten or drunk sth
senses.chn: （饮食留在口中不快的）回味，余味，苦味

senses.def: after sth has happened

ex.en: Anyone can be wise after the event.
ex.cn: 事后聪明谁都会。

senses.def: after sth has happened or been done, when it is too late to prevent it or change it

ex.en: On some vital decisions employees were only informed after the fact.
ex.cn: 有一些重大决策雇员只在事后才获悉。

senses.def: a thing that is thought of, said or added later, and is often not carefully planned
senses.chn: 事后想法，事后添加的事物（常未经周密考虑）

ex.en: They only invited Jack and Sarah as an afterthought.
ex.cn: 他们后来才想到邀请杰克和萨拉。

senses.def: at a later time; after an event that has already been mentioned

ex.en: Afterwards she was sorry for what she'd said.
ex.cn: 后来她后悔说了那些话。

ex.en: Let's go out now and eat afterwards.
ex.cn: 咱们现在出去，然后再吃饭。

ex.en: Shortly afterwards he met her again.
ex.cn: 不久之后，他又遇到了她。

senses.def: a section at the end of a book that says sth about the main text, and may be written by a different author
used when you are reacting to sth that has been said, or when you are angry or irritated by sth
senses.chn: （对他人的话作出反应或表示生气、恼怒）唔，啊，哎呀

ex.en: Ag, don't worry about it.
ex.cn: 哦，别担心。

ex.en: Ag, no man!
ex.cn: 嘿，不行！

senses.def: one more time; on another occasion

ex.en: Could you say it again, please?
ex.cn: 请再说一遍好吗？

ex.en: When will I see you again?
ex.cn: 我何时能再见到你？

ex.en: This must never happen again.
ex.cn: 这种事再也不能发生了。

ex.en: Once again (= as had happened several times before), the train was late.
ex.cn: 火车又晚点了。

ex.en: I've told you again and again (= many times) not to do that.
ex.cn: 我一再告诉过你别干那种事。

ex.en: I'll have to write it all over again (= again from the beginning).
ex.cn: 我得从头再写一遍。

senses.def: showing that sb/sth is in the same place or state that they were in originally

ex.en: He was glad to be home again.
ex.cn: 他很高兴又回到家了。

ex.en: She spends two hours a day getting to work and back again.
ex.cn: 她每天上班来回要花两小时。

ex.en: You'll soon feel well again.
ex.cn: 你很快就会康复的。

senses.def: added to an amount that is already there

ex.en: The cost is about half as much again as it was two years ago.
ex.cn: 现在的价格比两年前提高约一半。

ex.en: I'd like the same again (= the same amount or the same thing).
ex.cn: 我想再来一份同样的。

senses.def: used to show that a comment or fact is connected with what you have just said

ex.en: And again, we must think of the cost.
ex.cn: 再说，我们必须考虑成本。

senses.def: used to introduce a fact or an opinion that contrasts with what you have just said
senses.chn: （引出相对照的事实或看法）再说，另一方面

ex.en: We might buy it but then again we might not.
ex.cn: 我们可能买，不过也可能不买。

senses.def: used when you ask sb to tell you sth or repeat sth that you think they have told you already

ex.en: What was the name again?
ex.cn: 叫什么名字，再说一遍好不好？

senses.def: from time to time; occasionally

ex.en: Every now and again she checked to see if he was still asleep.
ex.cn: 她隔一会儿就看看他是否还在睡觉。

senses.def: used to ask sb to serve you the same drink as before

ex.en: Same again, please!
ex.cn: 和刚才一样的，请再来一份！

senses.def: often; on many or all occasions
senses.chn: 一次又一次；一再；屡屡；总是

ex.en: You will get a perfect result time after time if you follow these instructions.
ex.cn: 如果你遵循这些用法说明，每次都会得到最佳的效果。

senses.def: opposing or disagreeing with sb/sth

ex.en: the fight against terrorism
ex.cn: 反对恐怖主义的斗争

ex.en: We're playing against the league champions next week.
ex.cn: 下周我们要和联赛冠军队比赛。

ex.en: We were rowing against the current.
ex.cn: 我们划船逆流而上。

ex.en: That's against the law.
ex.cn: 那是违法的。

ex.en: She was forced to marry against her will.
ex.cn: 她被迫违背自己的心愿嫁了人。

ex.en: Are you for or against the death penalty?
ex.cn: 你赞成还是反对死刑？

senses.def: not to the advantage or favour of sb/sth

ex.en: The evidence is against him.
ex.cn: 证据对他不利。

ex.en: Her age is against her.
ex.cn: 她的年龄对她不利。

senses.def: close to, touching or hitting sb/sth

ex.en: Put the piano there, against the wall.
ex.cn: 把钢琴放在那儿，紧靠着墙。

ex.en: The rain beat against the windows.
ex.cn: 雨点击打着窗户。

senses.def: in order to prevent sth from happening or to reduce the damage caused by sth

ex.en: an injection against rabies
ex.cn: 狂犬病预防注射

ex.en: They took precautions against fire.
ex.cn: 他们采取了防火措施。

ex.en: Are we insured against theft?
ex.cn: 我们保了盗窃险没有？

senses.def: with sth in the background, as a contrast

ex.en: His red clothes stood out clearly against the snow.
ex.cn: 他的红衣服在白雪中格外显眼。

ex.en: The love story unfolds against a background of civil war.
ex.cn: 这爱情故事以内战为背景展开。

senses.def: used when you are comparing two things

ex.en: You must weigh the benefits against the cost.
ex.cn: 你一定要权衡利益与成本二者的得失。

ex.en: Check your receipts against the statement.
ex.cn: 核对你的收据与结算单是否相符。

ex.en: What's the rate of exchange against the dollar?
ex.cn: 与美元的兑换率是多少？

senses.def: in contrast with sth

ex.en: They got 27% of the vote as against 32% at the last election.
ex.cn: 这次选举他们得了 27% 的票，而上次他们得了 32%。

senses.def: you are unlikely to succeed because the conditions are not good for you
not natural; not moral
senses.chn: 违反自然的；有违天性的；不道德的

ex.en: Murder is a crime against nature.
ex.cn: 谋杀是一种有违天性的罪行。

senses.def: if you do sth against the clock, you do it fast in order to finish before a particular time
if you do sth against time, you do it as fast as you can because you do not have much time

ex.en: They're working against time to try and get people out of the rubble alive.
ex.cn: 他们正在争分夺秒，设法把人们从瓦砾中活着救出来。

senses.def: when you do not want to

ex.en: I was forced to sign the agreement against my will.
ex.cn: 我被迫违心地签了这份协议。

senses.def: if a person's mouth is agape, it is wide open, especially because they are surprised or shocked
Christian love rather than sexual or romantic love
a substance like jelly, used by scientists for growing cultures
a hard stone with bands or areas of colour, used in jewellery
a plant that grows in hot dry areas of N and S America, with sharp points on the leaves and tall groups of flowers
senses.chn: 龙舌兰（生长在南北美洲热带干旱地区）

senses.def: a long robe (= long piece of clothing) worn by men in some parts of W Africa
the number of years that a person has lived or a thing has existed

ex.en: He left school at the age of 18.
ex.cn: 他 18 岁读完中学。

ex.en: She needs more friends of her own age.
ex.cn: 她需要更多的同龄朋友。

ex.en: children from 5–10 years of age
ex.cn: 5 至 10 岁的儿童

ex.en: Young people of all ages go there to meet.
ex.cn: 不同年龄的年轻人都去那里聚会。

ex.en: When I was your age I was already married.
ex.cn: 我在你这个年纪时已经结婚了。

ex.en: He started playing the piano at an early age.
ex.cn: 他幼年开始弹钢琴。

senses.def: a particular period of a person's life

ex.en: middle age
ex.cn: 中年

ex.en: 15 is an awkward age.
ex.cn: 15 岁是个尴尬的年纪。

ex.en: He died of old age.
ex.cn: 他终其天年。

senses.def: a particular period of history

ex.en: the nuclear age
ex.cn: 核时代

ex.en: the age of the computer
ex.cn: 计算机时代

senses.def: the state of being old

ex.en: Wine improves with age.
ex.cn: 陈酒味浓。

ex.en: The jacket was showing signs of age.
ex.cn: 这件夹克已露出破旧的痕迹。

ex.en: the wisdom that comes with age
ex.cn: 随着年龄而增加的智慧

senses.def: a very long time

ex.en: I waited for ages.
ex.cn: 我等了好长时间。

ex.en: It'll probably take ages to find a parking space.
ex.cn: 大概得老半天才能找到停车位。

ex.en: Carlos left ages ago.
ex.cn: 卡洛斯老早就离开了。

ex.en: It's been an age since we've seen them.
ex.cn: 我们有很长一段时间没有见到他们了。

senses.def: a length of time which is a division of an epoch
to behave in a way that is suitable for sb of your age and not as though you were much younger
senses.chn: 行为和年龄相称；举止不再有孩子气

senses.def: when a person comes of age, they reach the age when they have an adult's legal rights and responsibilities
if sth comes of age, it reaches the stage of development at which people accept and value it
to seem as old as you really are and not younger or older
not legally old enough to do a particular thing

ex.en: It is illegal to sell cigarettes to children who are under age.
ex.cn: 售香烟给未到法定年龄的孩子是非法的。

senses.def: used in polite expressions to describe sb as 'very old'

ex.en: He was a man of advanced years.
ex.cn: 他年事已高。

ex.en: Even at my advanced age I still know how to enjoy myself!
ex.cn: 我虽说是黄昏暮年，也还懂得如何找乐儿！

senses.def: if you talk about a person being of a certain age, you mean that they are no longer young but not yet old
senses.chn: 不算年轻的；年纪不轻的；中年的

ex.en: The show appeals to an audience of a certain age.
ex.cn: 这个节目中年观众感兴趣。

senses.def: now, in the modern world
senses.chn: 当代；当今；在今天这个时代

senses.def: to realize that you are getting old, especially compared with people you are with who are younger than you
senses.chn: （尤指与较年轻者比）感到自己上年纪了，意识到自己老了

senses.def: a great age

ex.en: She finally learned to drive at the grand old age of 70.
ex.cn: 她终于在 70 岁高龄学会了开车。

senses.def: an age that is considered to be very old

ex.en: He lived to the ripe old age of 91.
ex.cn: 他活到了 91 岁的高龄。

senses.def: to become older

ex.en: As he aged, his memory got worse.
ex.cn: 他随着年事增高，记忆力就变差了。

ex.en: The population is aging (= more people are living longer).
ex.cn: 人口正在老龄化。

senses.def: to make sb/sth look, feel or seem older

ex.en: The shock has aged her.
ex.cn: 这次打击让她显得苍老了。

ex.en: Exposure to the sun ages the skin.
ex.cn: 太阳暴晒会使皮肤衰老。

senses.def: to develop in flavour over a period of time; to allow sth to do this

ex.en: The cheese is left to age for at least a year.
ex.cn: 这种奶酪至少要搁一年才成熟。

ex.en: The wine is aged in oak casks.
ex.cn: 这种酒是用栎木酒桶放陈的。

example.en: The shock has aged her.
example.cn: 这次打击让她显得苍老了。

example.en: Exposure to the sun ages the skin.
example.cn: 太阳暴晒会使皮肤衰老。

senses.def: of the age of

ex.en: They have two children aged six and nine.
ex.cn: 他们有两个小孩，一个六岁，一个九岁。

ex.en: volunteers aged between 25 and 40
ex.cn: 25 至 40 岁的志愿者

senses.def: very old

ex.en: my aged aunt
ex.cn: 我年迈的婶婶

ex.en: She's getting old—she's 75 next year.
ex.cn: 她上年纪了，明年就 75 岁了。

ex.en: She is very busy caring for two elderly relatives.
ex.cn: 她在忙着照顾两个年老的亲戚。

ex.en: Having aged relatives to stay in your house can be quite stressful.
ex.cn: 年迈的亲戚住在家里有时压力相当大。

ex.en: Everyone in my family is exceptionally long-lived.
ex.cn: 我们家每个人都特别长寿。

ex.en: clothes for the mature woman
ex.cn: 成年妇女的服装

senses.def: very old people

ex.en: services for the sick and the aged
ex.cn: 为病人和老人提供的服务

senses.def: people of a similar age or within a particular range of ages

ex.en: men in the older age group
ex.cn: 较年长组别的男子

ex.en: education for the 16–18 age group
ex.cn: 16 至 18 岁年龄段的教育

ex.en: Which age bracket are you? (Please tick the box).
ex.cn: 你在哪个年龄段？（请在方格中打钩。）

senses.def: the process of growing old

ex.en: signs of ageing
ex.cn: 变老的迹象

senses.def: becoming older and usually less useful, safe, healthy, etc.
senses.chn: 变老的；老朽的；变旧的；老化的

ex.en: ageing equipment
ex.cn: 老化的设备

ex.en: an ageing rock star
ex.cn: 日益年迈的摇滚乐歌星

senses.def: unfair treatment of people because they are considered too old
senses.chn: 对老年人的歧视；年龄歧视

senses.def: never looking old or never seeming to grow old
senses.chn: 青春永驻的；永不显老的

ex.en: Her beauty appeared ageless.
ex.cn: 她的美似乎不随时间改变。

senses.def: existing for ever; impossible to give an age to

ex.en: the ageless mystery of the universe
ex.cn: 宇宙永恒之谜

senses.def: the oldest or youngest age at which you are allowed to do sth

ex.en: the upper/lower age limit
ex.cn: 年龄上限／下限

senses.def: having existed for a very long time

ex.en: age-long traditions
ex.cn: 古老的传统

senses.def: a person of the same age or belonging to the same age group

ex.en: The toddlers participated in playgroups with age-mates.
ex.cn: 刚学会走路的孩子参加同年龄组的游戏班。

senses.def: a business or an organization that provides a particular service especially on behalf of other businesses or organizations
senses.chn: 服务机构；（尤指）代理机构，经销机构

ex.en: an advertising/employment agency
ex.cn: 广告公司；职业介绍所

ex.en: You can book at your local travel agency.
ex.cn: 你可以在当地的旅行社预订。

ex.en: international aid agencies caring for refugees
ex.cn: 国际援助难民事务所

senses.def: a government department that provides a particular service

ex.en: the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA)
ex.cn: （美国）中央情报局

senses.def: as a result of the action of sb/sth
a list of items to be discussed at a meeting

ex.en: The next item on the agenda is the publicity budget.
ex.cn: 议程表上的下一项是宣传预算。

senses.def: a plan of things to be done, or problems to be addressed
senses.chn: （待办事项或待解决问题的）计划，方案

ex.en: This is an ambitious agenda that will take time to implement.
ex.cn: 这是个宏大的计划，实施起来需要时间。

ex.en: For the government, education is now at the top of the agenda (= most important).
ex.cn: 对政府来说，教育是当务之急。

ex.en: Newspapers have been accused of trying to set the agenda for the government (= decide what is important).
ex.cn: 人们指责报章企图替政府决定政务的轻重缓急。

ex.en: In our company, quality is high on the agenda.
ex.cn: 我们公司高度重视质量。

ex.en: The Diary of Anne Frank
ex.cn: 《安妮日记》

ex.en: a bus/train timetable
ex.cn: 公共汽车／火车时刻表

senses.def: the intention behind what sb says or does, that is often secret

ex.en: The artist is letting his own agenda affect what was meant to be a community project.
ex.cn: 这本是个集体项目，可这个艺术家在其中掺入了自己的个人意图。

senses.def: a person whose job is to act for, or manage the affairs of, other people in business, politics, etc.
senses.chn: （企业、政治等的）代理人，经纪人

ex.en: an insurance agent
ex.cn: 保险经纪人

ex.en: Our agent in New York deals with all US sales.
ex.cn: 我们在纽约的代理商经办在整个美国的销售。

senses.def: a person whose job is to arrange work for an actor, musician, sports player, etc. or to find sb who will publish a writer's work
senses.chn: （演员、音乐家、运动员、作家等的）代理人，经纪人

ex.en: a theatrical/literary agent
ex.cn: 戏剧演出经纪人；文稿（出版）代理人

senses.def: a person or thing that has an important effect on a situation
senses.chn: 原动力，动因（指对事态起重要作用的人、事物）

ex.en: The charity has been an agent for social change.
ex.cn: 这个慈善机构一直推动社会变革。

senses.def: a chemical or a substance that produces an effect or a change or is used for a particular purpose

ex.en: cleaning/oxidizing agents
ex.cn: 清洁剂；氧化剂

senses.def: the person or thing that does an action (expressed as the subject of an active verb, or in a 'by' phrase with a passive verb)
senses.chn: 施事者；施动者；行为主体

senses.def: the representative of an Australian state or Canadian province in a foreign country
senses.chn: （澳大利亚州或加拿大省的）驻外代表

senses.def: a noun that refers to a person or thing that does an action, for example 'worker' or 'elevator'
senses.chn: 施动者名词，施事名词（指实施动作的人或物，如 worker 和 elevator）

senses.def: a person who is employed by a government to encourage people in political groups to do sth illegal so that they can be arrested
senses.chn: （受雇于政府，怂恿某些政治团体人士犯法以便将之逮捕的）密探，坐探

senses.def: the age at which sb is legally old enough to agree to have a sexual relationship
senses.chn: 同意年龄，承诺年龄（可发生性关系的法定年龄）

senses.def: having existed for a very long time

ex.en: an age-old custom/problem
ex.cn: 古老的风俗；由来已久的问题

senses.def: a group of boys or men of a similar age
to form into a mass or group; to collect things and form them into a mass or group

ex.en: These small particles agglomerate together to form larger clusters.
ex.cn: 这些颗粒聚结形成较大的团。

ex.en: They agglomerated many small pieces of research into a single large study.
ex.cn: 他们把许多小的研究课题汇集成一个大项目。

senses.def: a mass or collection of things

ex.en: a multimedia agglomerate (= group of companies)
ex.cn: 一个多媒体集团

senses.def: formed into a mass or group

example.en: They agglomerated many small pieces of research into a single large study.
example.cn: 他们把许多小的研究课题汇集成一个大项目。

senses.def: a group of things put together in no particular order or arrangement
an increase in the power or importance of a person or country
senses.chn: （个人、国家权力或重要性的）扩大，增加，提高

ex.en: Her sole aim is personal aggrandizement.
ex.cn: 她唯一的目的就是扩大个人权势。

senses.def: to make an illness or a bad or unpleasant situation worse

ex.en: Pollution can aggravate asthma.
ex.cn: 污染会使哮喘加重。

ex.en: Military intervention will only aggravate the conflict even further.
ex.cn: 军事介入只会使冲突加剧。

senses.def: to annoy sb, especially deliberately
an aggravated crime involves further unnecessary violence or unpleasant behaviour
a total number or amount made up of smaller amounts that are collected together
sand or broken stone that is used to make concrete or for building roads, etc.
senses.chn: （可制成混凝土或修路等用的）集料，骨料

senses.def: added together as a total or single amount
when the scores of a number of games are added together

ex.en: They won 4–2 on aggregate.
ex.cn: 他们以总分 4:2 获胜。

senses.def: made up of several amounts that are added together to form a total number

ex.en: aggregate demand/investment/turnover
ex.cn: 总需求；总投资；总成交量

ex.en: an aggregate win over their rivals
ex.cn: 以总分战胜他们的对手

senses.def: to put together different items, amounts, etc. into a single group or total

ex.en: The scores were aggregated with the first round totals to decide the winner.
ex.cn: 此次得分与第一轮所得总分合计决出优胜者。

senses.def: an Internet company that collects information about other companies' products and services and puts it on a single website
senses.chn: 信息汇集公司（汇集互联网其他公司的产品和服务信息并在单独的网站上发布）

ex.en: a news aggregator
ex.cn: 新闻汇总机构

senses.def: feelings of anger and hatred that may result in threatening or violent behaviour

ex.en: The research shows that computer games may cause aggression.
ex.cn: 研究显示，电脑游戏可能引起好斗情绪。

senses.def: a violent attack or threats by one person against another person or by one country against another country

ex.en: unprovoked military aggression
ex.cn: 无端军事侵犯

senses.def: angry, and behaving in a threatening way; ready to attack
senses.chn: 好斗的；挑衅的；侵略的；富于攻击性的

ex.en: He gets aggressive when he's drunk.
ex.cn: 他喝醉了就喜欢寻衅滋事。

ex.en: a dangerous aggressive dog
ex.cn: 一条危险的恶犬

senses.def: acting with force and determination in order to succeed
senses.chn: 气势汹汹的；声势浩大的；志在必得的

ex.en: an aggressive advertising campaign

outdoors

ex.cn: 户外午餐会

ex.cn: 在户外用餐

senses.def: very simple plants, such as seaweed, that have no real leaves, stems or roots, and that grow in or near water
a type of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent quantities
a country in North Africa
(a person) from Algeria

senses.def: a set of rules that must be followed when solving a particular problem
a woman who is a Muslim and has completed a religious journey to Mecca (often used as a title)
senses.chn: 哈娅（去麦加完成了正朝功课的穆斯林女子，常用作称谓）

senses.def: a man who is a Muslim and has completed a religious journey to Mecca (often used as a title)
senses.chn: 哈吉（去麦加完成了正朝功课的穆斯林男子，常用作称谓）

senses.def: used when a person, especially a criminal or an actor, is known by two names
senses.chn: （罪犯、演员等）又名，亦名，别名，化名

ex.en: Mick Clark, alias Sid Brown
ex.cn: 米克 · 克拉克，又名锡德 · 布朗

ex.en: Hercule Poirot, alias David Suchet (= David Suchet plays the part of Hercule Poirot)
ex.cn: 赫尔克里 · 波洛，由大卫 · 苏切特扮演

ex.en: David Suchet, alias Hercule Poirot of the famous TV series
ex.cn: 大卫 · 苏切特，即著名电视连续剧中的赫尔克里 · 波洛

senses.def: a false or different name, especially one that is used by a criminal

ex.en: He checked into the hotel under an alias.
ex.cn: 他用化名登记住进旅馆。

senses.def: a name that can be used instead of the actual name for a file, Internet address, etc.
senses.chn: （档案、互联网地址等用的）别名，假名

senses.def: evidence that proves that a person was in another place at the time of a crime and so could not have committed it

ex.en: The suspects all had alibis for the day of the robbery.
ex.cn: 嫌疑人均有证据证明抢劫当天不在犯罪现场。

senses.def: an excuse for sth that you have done wrong
a band which holds your hair back away from your face, but lets it hang freely at the back
used to describe a situation that is very strange, in which things happen that do not make any sense and are the opposite of what you would expect
senses.chn: （事情悖理且与想象的截然相反的）怪异局面

ex.en: The country's economic system is pure Alice in Wonderland.
ex.cn: 这个国家的经济制度实属匪夷所思。

senses.def: used to describe a business which makes a lot of money with little effort
senses.chn: 不费劲挣大钱；一本万利；摇钱树

senses.def: a town in central Australia, in the Northern Territory, now an important tourist centre
senses.chn: 艾丽斯斯普林斯（澳大利亚中部城镇，位于北部地方，现为重要的旅游中心）

senses.def: the act of performing a task quickly and carelessly, especially of washing or cleaning sth quickly
senses.chn: 草草了事，敷衍塞责（尤指快速地洗刷东西）

senses.def: strange and frightening; different from what you are used to

ex.en: an alien environment
ex.cn: 陌生的环境

ex.en: In a world that had suddenly become alien and dangerous, he was her only security.
ex.cn: 在一个突然变得陌生而危险的世界里，他是她唯一的守护神。

senses.def: from another country or society; foreign

ex.en: an alien culture
ex.cn: 异族文化

senses.def: not usual or acceptable
senses.chn: 不相容；相抵触；格格不入

ex.en: The idea is alien to our religion.
ex.cn: 这种思想与我们的宗教不相容。

ex.en: Cruelty was quite alien to him.
ex.cn: 他绝无残忍之心。

senses.def: connected with creatures from another world

ex.en: alien beings from outer space
ex.cn: 外星人

senses.def: a person who is not a citizen of the country in which they live or work

ex.en: an illegal alien
ex.cn: 非法外侨

senses.def: a creature from another world

ex.en: aliens from outer space
ex.cn: 外星人

example.en: The idea is alien to our religion.
example.cn: 这种思想与我们的宗教不相容。

senses.def: able to be taken or given away
to make sb less friendly or sympathetic towards you

ex.en: His comments have alienated a lot of young voters.
ex.cn: 他的评论使许多年轻选民离他而去。

senses.def: to make sb feel that they do not belong in a particular group
senses.chn: 使（与某群体）格格不入；使疏远

ex.en: Very talented children may feel alienated from the others in their class.
ex.cn: 天才出众的孩子可能觉得与班上的同学格格不入。

senses.def: on fire

ex.en: A cigarette set the dry grass alight.
ex.cn: 一支香烟把干草点燃了。

ex.en: Her dress caught alight in the fire.
ex.cn: 她的衣服让火烧着了。

senses.def: showing a feeling of happiness or excitement
to be very successful and gain the admiration of other people

ex.en: He's never going to set the world on fire with his paintings.
ex.cn: 他的绘画永远不会引起轰动。

senses.def: to land in or on sth after flying to it
to get out of a bus, a train or other vehicle
senses.chn: 从（公共汽车、火车等）下来

ex.en: Do not alight from a moving bus.
ex.cn: 公共汽车行驶时不要下车。

senses.def: to think of, find or notice sth, especially by chance
senses.chn: （尤指偶然地）想到，发现，注意到

ex.en: Eventually, we alighted on the idea of seeking sponsorship.
ex.cn: 最后我们偶然想到了寻求赞助。

ex.en: Her eyes suddenly alighted on the bundle of documents.
ex.cn: 她的目光突然落到了这捆文件上。

senses.def: the ability to deal with sth in a delicate and relaxed way

ex.en: She handles this difficult subject with a light touch.
ex.cn: 她处理起这个难题来得心应手。

senses.def: to arrange sth in the correct position, or to be in the correct position, in relation to sth else, especially in a straight line
senses.chn: 排列整齐；使对齐；（尤指）成一直线

ex.en: Make sure the shelf is aligned with the top of the cupboard.
ex.cn: 务必使搁架与橱柜顶端对齐。

ex.en: The top and bottom line of each column on the page should align.
ex.cn: 版面每栏的头一行和末一行要对齐。

senses.def: to change sth slightly so that it is in the correct relationship to sth else

ex.en: Domestic prices have been aligned with those in world markets.
ex.cn: 国内价格已调整到与世界市场一致。

senses.def: to publicly support an organization, a set of opinions or a person that you agree with
senses.chn: 公开支持（某组织、意见、人）

senses.def: arrangement in a straight line

ex.en: A bone in my spine was out of alignment.
ex.cn: 我的脊椎骨有一节脱位。

senses.def: political support given to one country or group by another

ex.en: Japan's alignment with the West
ex.cn: 日本与西方国家的结盟

senses.def: very similar

ex.en: My sister and I do not look alike.
ex.cn: 我和妹妹外貌不相像。

senses.def: in a very similar way

ex.en: They tried to treat all their children alike.
ex.cn: 他们尽量对自己的孩子一视同仁。

senses.def: used after you have referred to two people or groups, to mean 'both' or 'equally'

ex.en: Good management benefits employers and employees alike.
ex.cn: 良好的管理对雇主和雇员同样有利。

senses.def: used to show that you do not believe what sb has said
senses.chn: （表示不相信某人的话）说得好像真有这回事似的，煞有介事

senses.def: the passage in the body that carries food from the mouth to the anus
the money that a court orders sb to pay regularly to their former wife or husband when the marriage is ended
senses.chn: （离婚后一方给另一方的）生活费，扶养费

senses.def: wider at the bottom than at the top
senses.chn: 呈 A 字型的；宽下摆的

senses.def: one of the stages in a process or a line of argument
senses.chn: 链条中的一个环节；整个过程中的一个阶段

senses.def: a small amount of sth that is taken from a larger amount, especially when it is taken in order to do chemical tests on it
a quantity which can be exactly divided into another
used to describe the group of people who are considered to be the most famous, successful or important
senses.chn: 第一等的；最出名（或成功、重要）的

ex.en: He only invited A-list celebrities to his parties.
ex.cn: 他只邀请头等名流参加他的聚会。

senses.def: used to say that sb told you sth but you do not want to say who it was
senses.chn: （不想说出是谁告诉的）有人告诉我的，不告诉你我是怎么知道的

senses.def: living; not dead

ex.en: We don't know whether he's alive or dead.
ex.cn: 我们不知道他是死是活。

ex.en: Is your mother still alive?
ex.cn: 你的母亲还健在吗？

ex.en: Doctors kept the baby alive for six weeks.
ex.cn: 医生使婴儿活了六周。

ex.en: I was glad to hear you're alive and well.
ex.cn: 听说你健在我很高兴。

ex.en: She had to steal food just to stay alive.
ex.cn: 她得偷食物才不至于饿死。

ex.en: He was buried alive in the earthquake.
ex.cn: 地震把他活埋了。

senses.def: full of emotion, excitement, activity, etc.
senses.chn: 情绪饱满；激动兴奋；有生气；有活力

ex.en: Ed was alive with happiness.
ex.cn: 埃德高兴得眉飞色舞。

senses.def: continuing to exist

ex.en: to keep a tradition alive
ex.cn: 继承传统

senses.def: full of living or moving things

ex.en: The pool was alive with goldfish.
ex.cn: 池塘里满是游来游去的金鱼。

senses.def: aware of sth; knowing sth exists and is important

ex.en: to be alive to the dangers/facts/possibilities
ex.cn: 意识到危险；认识到事实；注意到可能

senses.def: very active, healthy or popular
senses.chn: 充满活力；活蹦乱跳；生气勃勃；流行

senses.def: to make sth interesting

ex.en: The pictures bring the book alive.
ex.cn: 图片使得这本书生动有趣。

senses.def: to become interesting and exciting

ex.en: The game came alive in the second half.
ex.cn: 比赛在下半场变得有看头了。

senses.def: to become busy and full of activity

ex.en: The city starts to come alive after dark.
ex.cn: 这座城市天黑以后便热闹起来。

senses.def: to show interest in sth and become excited about it

ex.en: She came alive as she talked about her job.
ex.cn: 她一谈到她的工作精神就来了。

senses.def: to criticize or punish sb severely because you are extremely angry with them
senses.chn: （对某人极为气愤而）尖锐批评，严厉惩罚，横加指责

senses.def: to defeat sb completely in an argument, a competition, etc.
senses.chn: （辩论、比赛等中）大败某人，完全战胜某人

ex.en: The defence lawyers are going to eat you alive tomorrow.
ex.cn: 辩护律师明天一定会彻底打败你们。

senses.def: to bite sb many times

ex.en: I was being eaten alive by mosquitoes.
ex.cn: 蚊子要把我活活吃了。

senses.def: very active, healthy or popular
senses.chn: 充满活力；活蹦乱跳；生气勃勃；流行

senses.def: a person who is lively and full of energy
senses.chn: 活跃而精力充沛的人；生龙活虎的人

senses.def: a chemical substance that reacts with acids to form a salt and gives a solution with a pH of more than seven when it is dissolved in water
having the nature of an alkali
containing alkali

ex.en: alkaline soil
ex.cn: 碱性土壤

senses.def: the state of being or containing an alkali
a poisonous substance found in some plants. There are many different alkaloids and some are used as the basis for drugs.
any of a series of compounds that contain carbon and hydrogen

ex.en: Methane and propane are alkanes.
ex.cn: 甲烷和丙烷是烷烃。

senses.def: any of a series of gases that contain hydrogen and carbon and that have a double bond between two of the carbon (= force of attraction) between two of the carbon atoms
the whole number of

ex.en: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
ex.cn: 所有的马都是动物，但并不是所有的动物都是马。

ex.en: Cars were coming from all directions (= every direction).
ex.cn: 汽车从四面八方驶来。

ex.en: All the people you invited are coming.
ex.cn: 你邀请的人都会来。

ex.en: All my plants have died.
ex.cn: 我的花草全死光了。

ex.en: All five men are hard workers.
ex.cn: 五个人全都工作努力。

senses.def: the whole amount of

ex.en: All wood tends to shrink.
ex.cn: 所有的木头都会收缩。

ex.en: You've had all the fun and I've had all the hard work.
ex.cn: 享受都是你得，苦活儿都是我做。

ex.en: All this mail must be answered.
ex.cn: 所有这些信件都必须回复。

ex.en: He has lost all his money.
ex.cn: 他失去了所有的钱。

senses.def: used with singular nouns showing sth has been happening for a whole period of time
senses.chn: （与单数名词连用，表示某事在某段时间内持续发生）全部的，整个的

ex.en: He's worked hard all year.
ex.cn: 他一年到头都在辛勤劳动。

ex.en: She was unemployed for all that time.
ex.cn: 那段时间她一直失业。

senses.def: the greatest possible

ex.en: In all honesty (= being as honest as I can), I can't agree.
ex.cn: 说实在的，我不能同意。

senses.def: consisting or appearing to consist of one thing only

ex.en: The magazine was all advertisements.
ex.cn: 这份杂志全是广告。

ex.en: She was all smiles (= smiling a lot).
ex.cn: 她笑容满面。

senses.def: any whatever

ex.en: He denied all knowledge of the crime.
ex.cn: 他矢口否认对这桩罪案知情。

senses.def: and other similar things

ex.en: I'm bored by history—dates and battles and all that stuff.
ex.cn: 我厌烦历史，尽是些年代啦战争啦什么的。

senses.def: not particularly good, well, etc.

ex.en: He doesn't sing all that well.
ex.cn: 他唱得并不特别好。

senses.def: not as much as has been suggested

ex.en: They're not as rich as all that.
ex.cn: 他们并不是那么富有。

ex.en: We didn't play particularly well, but we didn't do as badly as all that.
ex.cn: 我们打得不是特别好，但也不是那么差。

senses.def: used to express surprise because sb/sth seems the least likely person, example, etc.

ex.en: I didn't think you, of all people, would become a vegetarian.
ex.cn: 我真没有想到，在所有的人当中偏偏你会成为素食者。

senses.def: used to express anger

ex.en: I've locked myself out. Of all the stupid things to do!
ex.cn: 我把自己锁在门外了，真是蠢得很！

senses.def: despite

ex.en: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.
ex.cn: 这本书虽然文体清晰，但读起来并不容易。

senses.def: used to say that sth is not important or of no interest or value to you/sb
senses.chn: （表示对某人不重要、无价值或无所谓）

ex.en: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
ex.cn: 据我所知，她还住在波士顿。

ex.en: You can do what you like, for all I care.
ex.cn: 你想干什么就可以干什么，我才不管呢。

ex.en: For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.
ex.cn: 那件事带来的好处不多，我们本不该操心的。

senses.def: the whole number or amount

ex.en: All of the food has gone.
ex.cn: 食物全光了。

ex.en: They've eaten all of it.
ex.cn: 他们全吃光了。

ex.en: They've eaten it all.
ex.cn: 他们吃得一点也没剩。

ex.en: I invited some of my colleagues but not all.
ex.cn: 我邀请了一些同事，并不是所有的。

ex.en: Not all of them were invited.
ex.cn: 他们当中并不是人人都受到邀请。

ex.en: All of them enjoyed the party.
ex.cn: 他们都喜欢那次聚会。

senses.def: the only thing; everything
senses.chn: 唯一的事物；所有的事物；一切

ex.en: All I want is peace and quiet.
ex.cn: 我只要和平安宁。

ex.en: It was all that I had.
ex.cn: 那就是我拥有的一切。

ex.en: We have invited fifty people altogether.
ex.cn: 我们共邀请了五十人。

ex.en: I am not altogether convinced by this argument.
ex.cn: 我不完全信服这一论点。

ex.en: Can you put your books all together in this box?
ex.cn: 你能把你的书都放进这个箱子里吗？

ex.en: Let's sing 'Happy Birthday'. All together now!
ex.cn: 咱们来唱 “生日快乐”。现在一起唱！

senses.def: when everything is considered
senses.chn: 从各方面考虑；总的说来

ex.en: All in all it had been a great success.
ex.cn: 总的说来，那是个巨大的成功。

senses.def: having two or more uses, functions, etc.

ex.en: It's a corkscrew and bottle-opener all in one.
ex.cn: 这是一物多用，既是瓶塞钻，又是开瓶器。

senses.def: also; included; in addition

ex.en: She jumped into the river, clothes and all (= with her clothes on).
ex.cn: 她连衣服也没脱就跳进河中。

senses.def: as well; too

ex.en: 'I'm freezing.' 'Yeah, me and all.'
ex.cn: “我都快冻僵了。” “对，我也是。”

senses.def: in any way; to any degree

ex.en: I didn't enjoy it at all.
ex.cn: 我一点也不喜欢。

senses.def: as a total

ex.en: There were twelve of us in all for dinner.
ex.cn: 我们一共十二人吃饭。

ex.en: That's £25.40 in all.
ex.cn: 总计 25.40 英镑。

senses.def: used as a polite reply to an expression of thanks
senses.chn: （回答道谢的客套语）不用谢，哪儿的话

ex.en: 'Thanks very much for your help.' 'Not at all, it was a pleasure.'
ex.cn: “多谢你帮了忙。” “别客气，不用谢。”

senses.def: everything you have

ex.en: They gave their all (= fought and died) in the war.
ex.cn: 他们在战争中英勇牺牲，献出了一切。

senses.def: most important of all; especially

ex.en: Above all, keep in touch.
ex.cn: 最要紧的是保持联系。

ex.en: This case emphasizes / highlights the importance of honest communication between managers and employees.
ex.cn: 这个事例凸显出经理与员工之间坦诚交流的重要性。

ex.en: Effective communication skills are essential / crucial / vital.
ex.cn: 有效的交流技巧是至关重要的。

ex.en: It should be noted that this study considers only verbal communication. Non-verbal communication is not dealt with here.
ex.cn: 应该注意的是本研究只考查了言语交流，在此没有涉及非言语交流。

ex.en: It is important to remember that / An important point to remember is that non-verbal communication plays a key role in getting your message across.
ex.cn: 非言语交流在传递信息过程中起着重要的作用，记住这一点非常重要。

ex.en: Communication is not only about the words you use but also your body language and, especially / above all, the effectiveness with which you listen.
ex.cn: 交流不仅涉及使用的词语，同时也涉及身体语言，尤其与能否有效听取对方的话有关。

senses.def: despite what has been said or expected

ex.en: So you made it after all!
ex.cn: 你毕竟成功了！

senses.def: used when you are explaining sth, or giving a reason
senses.chn: （解释或说明理由）别忘了，到底

ex.en: He should have paid. He suggested it, after all.
ex.cn: 他本来就应该付款，反正他自己也这么提出。

senses.def: to kill yourself
to kill yourself
despite

ex.en: For all its clarity of style, the book is not easy reading.
ex.cn: 这本书虽然文体清晰，但读起来并不容易。

senses.def: used to say that sth is not important or of no interest or value to you/sb
senses.chn: （表示对某人不重要、无价值或无所谓）

ex.en: For all I know she's still living in Boston.
ex.cn: 据我所知，她还住在波士顿。

ex.en: You can do what you like, for all I care.
ex.cn: 你想干什么就可以干什么，我才不管呢。

ex.en: For all the good it's done we might as well not have bothered.
ex.cn: 那件事带来的好处不多，我们本不该操心的。

senses.def: in or from all directions; everywhere

ex.en: We realized we were surrounded on all sides.
ex.cn: 我们意识到我们被包围了。

ex.en: Disaster threatens on every side.
ex.cn: 灾祸四伏。

senses.def: completely

ex.en: She was dressed all in white.
ex.cn: 她穿得一身白。

ex.en: He lives all alone.
ex.cn: 他索居独处。

ex.en: The coffee went all over my skirt.
ex.cn: 咖啡溅了我一裙子。

senses.def: very

ex.en: She was all excited.
ex.cn: 她非常激动。

ex.en: Now don't get all upset about it.
ex.cn: 别再为那件事那么难过了。

senses.def: used to show that sth is more than you would like

ex.en: I'm all too aware of the problems.
ex.cn: 我实在太明白这些问题了。

ex.en: The end of the trip came all too soon.
ex.cn: 这次旅行结束得未免太快了。

senses.def: to each side

ex.en: The score was four all.
ex.cn: 比分是四平。

senses.def: all the time; from the beginning

ex.en: I realized it was in my pocket all along.
ex.cn: 我发觉它一直就在我口袋里。

senses.def: so much better, harder, etc.

ex.en: We'll have to work all the harder with two people off sick.
ex.cn: 有两个人病了没上班，所以我们得加把劲干。
