ex.cn: 起价 1 000 美元。

senses.def: used to say that sb/sth is as good, bad, etc. as they can be
senses.chn: 处于最佳（或最差等）状态；在全盛（或谷底等）时期

ex.en: This was Murray at his best.
ex.cn: 这是穆雷的最佳表现。

ex.en: The garden's at its most beautiful in June.
ex.cn: 六月的花园最美丽。

senses.def: used with adjectives to show how well sb does sth
senses.chn: （与形容词连用，表示能力）在…方面

ex.en: I'm good at French.
ex.cn: 我的法语很好。

ex.en: She's hopeless at managing people.
ex.cn: 她对人事管理一窍不通。

senses.def: used with adjectives to show the cause of sth

ex.en: They were impatient at the delay.
ex.cn: 他们对拖延不耐烦了。

ex.en: She was delighted at the result.
ex.cn: 她对这个结果感到高兴。

senses.def: in response to sth

ex.en: They attended the dinner at the chairman's invitation.
ex.cn: 他们应董事长之邀出席了宴会。

senses.def: used when giving a telephone number

ex.en: You can reach me at 637-2335, extension 354.
ex.cn: 你可以打 637-2335 这个电话号码，转分机 354 与我联系。

senses.def: the symbol ( @ ) used in email addresses
senses.chn: （用于电子邮箱地址中的符号 @）

senses.def: used when you are giving an extra piece of information

ex.en: He managed to buy a car after all—and a nice one at that.
ex.cn: 他终于设法买了一辆小轿车，而且还挺不错的。

senses.def: to be doing sth, especially sth bad

ex.en: Look at all that graffiti—those kids have been at it again.
ex.cn: 瞧，那么多涂鸦，又是那些孩子干的好事。

senses.def: a place or an activity that is very popular or fashionable
senses.chn: 盛大活动（场合）；流行活动（地方）

ex.en: Judging by the crowds waiting to get in, this seems to be where it's at.
ex.cn: 从等待入场的人群来看，这好像是个盛大活动。

senses.def: used to emphasize or show that sth is true or will happen in spite of other circumstances

ex.en: I think she'll agree to do it but in any event, all she can say is 'no'.
ex.cn: 我想她会同意做的，但无论怎样，她只能说 “不”。

senses.def: always

ex.en: Our representatives are ready to help you at all times.
ex.cn: 我们的代表随时准备帮助你。

senses.def: having nothing to do and not knowing what you want to do

ex.en: Come and see us, if you're at a loose end.
ex.cn: 你要是闲着无事就来我们这儿坐坐吧。

senses.def: not knowing what to say or do

ex.en: His comments left me at a loss for words.
ex.cn: 他的评论让我不知说什么才好。

ex.en: I'm at a loss what to do next.
ex.cn: 我对下一步做什么心里没谱。

senses.def: in a poor state; worse than usual

ex.en: Morale among teachers is at a low ebb.
ex.cn: 教师的精神面貌不佳。

senses.def: not long in advance; without warning or time for preparation
senses.chn: 随时；一经通知立即；没有准备时间

ex.en: This was the best room we could get at such short notice.
ex.cn: 这是我们临时能弄到的最好的房间了。

ex.en: You must be ready to leave at a moment's notice.
ex.cn: 你必须随时准备出发。

senses.def: very early, especially when this is annoying

ex.en: The job involved getting up at some unearthly hour to catch the first train.
ex.cn: 这工作需要起大早赶头班火车。

senses.def: very early or very late and therefore annoying
senses.chn: 一大早（或很晚）；在十分不便的时间

senses.def: under any circumstances
senses.chn: 在任何情况下；无论如何

ex.en: He is determined to win at any cost.
ex.cn: 他决心无论如何要争取胜利。

senses.def: whatever the cost or the difficulties may be
senses.chn: 不惜任何代价；无论如何

ex.en: We want peace at any price.
ex.cn: 为了争取和平，我们不惜任何代价。

senses.def: used to say that a particular fact is true despite what has happened in the past or what may happen in the future
senses.chn: （强调事情的真实性）无论如何，不管怎样

ex.en: Well, that's one good piece of news at any rate.
ex.cn: 不管怎么说，那是个好消息。

ex.en: I may be away on business next week but at any rate I'll be back by Friday.
ex.cn: 我下周可能要出差，但无论如何，我最晚星期五回来。

senses.def: used to show that you are being more accurate about sth that you have just said
senses.chn: （表示说得更加确切）不管怎样，至少

ex.en: He said he'll be coming tomorrow. At any rate, I think that's what he said.
ex.cn: 他说他明天要来。至少，我认为他是这么说的。

senses.def: used to show that what you have just said is not as important as what you are going to say

ex.en: There were maybe 60 or 70 people there. At any rate, the room was packed.
ex.cn: 那里也许有六七十人吧。反正屋子里挤得严严实实。

senses.def: used to say that sth could be done or used in a particular situation if it is really necessary

ex.en: We can get six people round this table at a pinch.
ex.cn: 必要时，这张桌子可以坐六个人。

senses.def: if sth is at a premium, there is little of it available and it is difficult to get

ex.en: Space is at a premium in a one-bedroomed apartment.
ex.cn: 单居室公寓的空间是很有限的。

senses.def: at a higher than normal price

ex.en: Shares are selling at a premium.
ex.cn: 这种股票以高于面值的价格出售。

senses.def: costing a lot of money

ex.en: You can buy strawberries all year round, but at a price.
ex.cn: 草莓一年到头都买得到，不过很贵。

senses.def: involving sth unpleasant

ex.en: He'll help you—at a price!
ex.cn: 他会帮助你的，但要付出代价！

senses.def: used to say that sth is possible, but only with difficulty
senses.chn: 不得已时；为难地；勉强地

ex.en: We can provide accommodation for six people at a push.
ex.cn: 我们勉强可以安排六个人住宿。

senses.def: very quickly
very slowly
used in connection with sb who is still young and does not have much experience
senses.chn: 在少不更事的…岁时；在不谙世故的…岁上

ex.en: He left home at the tender age of 15.
ex.cn: 他 15 岁离家，还少不更事。

ex.en: She shouldn't be having to deal with problems like this at such a tender age.
ex.cn: 她小小年纪涉世未深，实在不必应对这样的问题。

senses.def: separately or in groups of two, three, etc. on each occasion

ex.en: We had to go and see the principal one at a time.
ex.cn: 我们得逐一去见校长。

ex.en: She ran up the stairs two at a time.
ex.cn: 她一步两阶地跑上楼梯。

senses.def: related to the attitudes and behaviour of the first humans

ex.en: an atavistic urge/instinct/fear
ex.cn: 返祖倾向／本能；原始畏惧

senses.def: the loss of full control of the body's movements
senses.chn: 共济失调，运动失调（表现为动作不稳、不协调）

senses.def: when an animal that is being hunted is at bay, it must turn and face the dogs and hunters because it is impossible to escape from them
senses.chn: （猎物）被围困，被迫作困兽之斗

senses.def: used for saying what is the best opinion you can have of sb/sth, or the best thing that can happen, when the situation is bad
senses.chn: （表达最正面的看法或恶劣状况下可能出现的最好转机）充其量

ex.en: Their response to the proposal was, at best, cool.
ex.cn: 他们对提议的反应充其量只能说是漠然置之。

ex.en: We can't arrive before Friday at best.
ex.cn: 我们无论如何星期五之前也到不了。

senses.def: used to say what sb/sth is really like
senses.chn: 归根结底；本质上；实际上

ex.en: Their offer to help was at bottom self-centred.
ex.cn: 他们提出要帮忙，这其实还是他们为自己考虑。

senses.def: for only the amount of money that is needed to make or get sth, without any profit being added on

ex.en: goods sold at cost
ex.cn: 按成本价销售的商品

senses.def: if two people are at daggers drawn, they are very angry with each other
so ill/sick that you may die
the best sports team in a school, club, etc.
a group of the best workers, soldiers, etc.
a room or building in which an artist works
a lot of anger or worry about sth that is not important
senses.chn: 茶杯里的风暴；大惊小怪；小题大做

senses.def: at the previous speed
existing or considered without relation to time
senses.chn: 非时间的；不受时间影响的

senses.def: everywhere or every time you try and do sth

ex.en: At every turn I met with disappointment.
ex.cn: 我事事都不顺心。

senses.def: at or in the beginning

ex.en: I didn't like the job much at first.
ex.cn: 起初我并不很喜欢这个工作。

ex.en: At first I thought he was shy, but then I discovered he was just not interested in other people.
ex.cn: 起先我以为他腼腆，后来才发现他就是对别人没兴趣。

ex.en: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again.
ex.cn: 一次不成功就反复尝试。

ex.en: The brochure is divided into two sections, dealing firstly with basic courses and secondly with advanced ones.
ex.cn: 小册子分为两部分：第一部分涉及基础课程，第二部分涉及高级课程。

ex.en: Maggie had seen him nearly every day at first. Now she saw him much less.
ex.cn: 起初玛吉几乎每天都见到他，现在见到他的次数少得多了。

senses.def: when you first look at or think about sth, often rather quickly

ex.en: At first glance the problem seemed easy.
ex.cn: 乍一看问题似乎很简单。

senses.def: when you first begin to consider sth

ex.en: At first sight, it may look like a generous offer, but always read the small print.
ex.cn: 乍一看，对方给出的条件好像很优厚，但任何时候都不要小看那些小号字印刷的附加条款。

senses.def: when you see sb/sth for the first time

ex.en: It was love at first sight (= we fell in love the first time we saw each other).
ex.cn: 我们一见钟情。

senses.def: using as much energy as possible, or the greatest possible amount of supplies
senses.chn: 竭尽全力；以最大财力物力

ex.en: Fire crews have been operating at full stretch.
ex.cn: 各消防队一直在全力以赴。

senses.def: while threatening sb or being threatened with a gun
senses.chn: 用枪威胁；在枪口威胁下

ex.en: The driver was robbed at gunpoint.
ex.cn: 司机遭持枪抢劫。

senses.def: flown at the middle of the mast as a sign of respect for a person who has just died
senses.chn: 降半旗，下半旗（以示哀悼）

ex.en: Flags were flown at half mast on the day of his funeral.
ex.cn: 在他葬礼那天降了半旗。

senses.def: used to say what sb is really like even though they may seem to be sth different

ex.en: He's still a socialist at heart.
ex.cn: 他本质上还是个社会主义者。

senses.def: the belief that God does not exist
a person who believes that God does not exist
a physical condition in which your head is painful or you cannot think clearly as a result of an illness or of drinking too much alcohol
senses.chn: （由于疾病或饮酒过量）晕头涨脑，稀里糊涂

senses.def: the ability to accept criticism, insults, etc. without becoming upset
the lack of ability to accept criticism, insults, etc. without becoming upset
a person who competes in sports

ex.en: Olympic athletes
ex.cn: 奥运会运动员

senses.def: a person who competes in sports such as running and jumping
a person who is good at sports and physical exercise

ex.en: She is a natural athlete.
ex.cn: 她是个天生的运动健将。

senses.def: an infectious skin disease that affects the feet, especially between the toes
physically strong, fit and active

ex.en: an athletic figure/build
ex.cn: 健壮的体形／体格

ex.en: a tall, slim athletic girl
ex.cn: 修长健美的姑娘

senses.def: connected with sports such as running, jumping and throwing (= athletics )
senses.chn: 体育运动的；田径运动的

ex.en: an athletic club/coach
ex.cn: 运动员俱乐部／教练

senses.def: sports such as running and jumping that people compete in
any sports that people compete in

ex.en: students involved in all forms of college athletics
ex.cn: 参加各种大学体育运动的学生

senses.def: in a person's own house, flat/apartment, etc.

ex.en: I phoned you last night, but you weren't at home.
ex.cn: 我昨晚给你打电话了，但你不在家。

ex.en: Oh no, I left my purse at home.
ex.cn: 糟了，我把钱包落在家里了。

ex.en: He lived at home (= with his parents) until he was thirty.
ex.cn: 他一直和父母同住到三十岁。

senses.def: comfortable and relaxed

ex.en: Sit down and make yourself at home.
ex.cn: 坐下，别拘束。

ex.en: Simon feels very at home on a horse.
ex.cn: 西蒙骑马得心应手。

senses.def: in sb's own country, not in a foreign country

ex.en: The president is not as popular at home as he is abroad.
ex.cn: 总统在国内不如在国外受欢迎。

senses.def: if a sports team plays at home, it plays in the town, etc. that it comes from

ex.en: Leeds are playing at home this weekend.
ex.cn: 本周末利兹队将在主场进行比赛。

ex.en: Is the match on Saturday at home or away?
ex.cn: 星期六的比赛是在主场还是在客场？

senses.def: a party in sb's home

ex.en: We're having an at-home—can you come?
ex.cn: 我们要在家中聚会，你能来吗？

senses.def: done or taking place at home

ex.en: an at-home job
ex.cn: 一份在家里做的工作

senses.def: staying at home rather than going out to work

ex.en: at-home dads
ex.cn: 家庭全职爸爸

senses.def: across; from one side to the other

ex.en: They put a table athwart the doorway.
ex.cn: 他们把桌子横放在门口。

senses.def: not agreeing with; opposite to

ex.en: His statement ran athwart what was previously said.
ex.cn: 他讲的话与先前所说的相抵触。

senses.def: the word for the sound people make when they sneeze
a story, an excuse, etc. that is full of lies
while being threatened, or threatening sb, with a knife

ex.en: She was raped at knifepoint.
ex.cn: 她遭持刀强奸。

senses.def: the capital city of the US state of Georgia
senses.chn: 亚特兰大（美国佐治亚州首府）

senses.def: the time used in summer in an area that includes the east of Canada, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands, that is three hours behind UTC
senses.chn: 大西洋夏令时间（加拿大东部、波多黎各、美属维尔京群岛的夏季时间，比协调世界时晚三个小时）

senses.def: the time used in winter in an area that includes the east of Canada, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands, that is four hours behind UTC
senses.chn: 大西洋标准时间（加拿大东部、波多黎各、美属维尔京群岛的冬季时间，比协调世界时晚四个小时）

senses.def: an island full of beauty and wealth, that was said to have been covered by the sea and lost. There are many stories about people's attempts to find it.
senses.chn: 亚特兰蒂斯，大西岛（一座美丽富饶的海岛，据说已沉入海底消失）

senses.def: as a whole; in general

ex.en: the opinion of the public at large
ex.cn: 普通大众的意见

senses.def: not captured; free

ex.en: Her killer is still at large.
ex.cn: 杀害她的凶手仍然逍遥法外。

senses.def: a book of maps

ex.en: a world atlas
ex.cn: 世界地图册

ex.en: a road atlas of Europe
ex.cn: 欧洲交通地图册

senses.def: not less than

ex.en: It'll cost at least 500 dollars.
ex.cn: 这东西至少要花 500 美元。

ex.en: She must be at least 40.
ex.cn: 她至少应该有 40 岁了。

ex.en: Cut the grass at least once a week in summer.
ex.cn: 夏天至少每周割一次草。

ex.en: I've known her at least as long as you have.
ex.cn: 我认识她至少和你认识她的时间一样久了。

senses.def: used to add a positive comment about a negative situation
senses.chn: （用于对否定情况补充肯定的评论）起码

ex.en: She may be slow but at least she's reliable.
ex.cn: 她虽然迟钝，但起码还很可靠。

senses.def: even if nothing else is true or you do nothing else

ex.en: You could at least listen to what he says.
ex.cn: 你至少可以听一听他说些什么。

ex.en: Well, at least they weren't bored.
ex.cn: 唔，反正他们没有厌烦。

senses.def: used to limit or make what you have just said less definite
senses.chn: （用以减轻前面所说的话的肯定性）至少

ex.en: They seldom complained—officially at least.
ex.cn: 他们很少抱怨，至少不在正式场合这样做。

ex.en: It works, at least I think it does.
ex.cn: 它行，反正我认为它行。

senses.def: with no particular activities; free

ex.en: Spend the afternoon at leisure in the town centre.
ex.cn: 下午到城中心区玩儿去吧。

senses.def: without hurrying

ex.en: Let's have lunch so we can talk at leisure.
ex.cn: 咱们吃午饭吧，边吃边谈。

senses.def: for a long time and in detail

ex.en: He quoted at length from the report.
ex.cn: 他大段大段地引用报告中的话。

ex.en: We have already discussed this matter at great length.
ex.cn: 我们已经十分详尽地讨论了这个问题。

senses.def: after a long time
senses.chn: 经过一段长时间以后；最后

ex.en: 'I'm still not sure,' he said at length.
ex.cn: “我还是没把握。” 他最后说道。

senses.def: no longer in prison or in a cage
having the right or freedom to do sth

ex.en: You are at liberty to say what you like.
ex.cn: 你尽可畅所欲言。

senses.def: after a long time

ex.en: At long last his prayers had been answered.
ex.cn: 他的祷告终于应验了。

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'automated teller machine'
senses.chn: 自动柜员机，自动取款机（全写为 automated teller machine）

senses.def: a plastic card used to get money from a cash machine (= a machine in or outside a bank)
the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth
senses.chn: （围绕地球的）大气，大气圈，大气层

ex.en: the upper atmosphere
ex.cn: 高层大气

ex.en: pollution of the atmosphere
ex.cn: 大气污染

senses.def: a mixture of gases that surrounds another planet or a star

ex.en: Saturn's atmosphere
ex.cn: 土星的大气

senses.def: the air in a room or in a confined space; the air around a place
senses.chn: （房间、封闭空间或某处的）空气

ex.en: a smoky/stuffy atmosphere
ex.cn: 烟雾弥漫的／闷热的空气

ex.en: These plants love warm, humid atmospheres.
ex.cn: 这些植物喜欢温暖潮湿的空气。

senses.def: the feeling or mood that you have in a particular place or situation; a feeling between two people or in a group of people

ex.en: a party atmosphere
ex.cn: 聚会的气氛

ex.en: The hotel offers a friendly atmosphere and personal service.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆提供个人服务，使客人感到宾至如归。

ex.en: Use music and lighting to create a romantic atmosphere.
ex.cn: 用音乐和照明创造一种浪漫的气氛。

ex.en: There was an atmosphere of mutual trust between them.
ex.cn: 他们之间以前有一种相互信任的气氛。

ex.en: The children grew up in an atmosphere of violence and insecurity.
ex.cn: 这些孩子在暴力和无安全感的环境中长大。

ex.en: The old house is full of atmosphere (= it's very interesting).
ex.cn: 这座老房子情趣盎然。

senses.def: a situation when people do not say anything, but feel embarrassed or uncomfortable
senses.chn: 令人尴尬（或不安）的沉默（或气氛）

senses.def: related to the earth's atmosphere

ex.en: atmospheric pollution/conditions/pressure
ex.cn: 大气污染／状况／压力

senses.def: creating an exciting or emotional mood
senses.chn: 令人激动的；使人动感情的

ex.en: atmospheric music
ex.cn: 有感染力的音乐

senses.def: qualities in sth that create a particular atmosphere
noises that sometimes interrupt a radio broadcast
an island made of coral and shaped like a ring with a lake of sea water (called a lagoon) in the middle
the smallest particle (1) of a chemical element that can exist

ex.en: the splitting of the atom
ex.cn: 原子的分裂

ex.en: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
ex.cn: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。

senses.def: a bomb that explodes using the energy that is produced when an atom or atoms are split
connected with atoms or an atom

ex.en: atomic structure
ex.cn: 原子结构

senses.def: related to the energy that is produced when atoms are split; related to weapons that use this energy

ex.en: atomic energy/power
ex.cn: 原子能／动力

ex.en: the atomic bomb
ex.cn: 原子弹

senses.def: an extremely accurate clock that uses the movement of atoms or molecules to measure time
senses.chn: 原子钟（利用原子或分子运动计时，精确度极高）

senses.def: the number of atoms in one molecule of a substance

the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom, which is characteristic of a chemical element. Elements are placed in the periodic table (= centre) of an atom, which is characteristic of a chemical element. Elements are placed in the periodic table according to their atomic numbers.
senses.chn: 原子序数（指原子在元素周期表中的序号）

senses.def: the theory that all elements are made up of small particles called atoms which are made up of a central nucleus surrounded by moving electrons
the idea of analysing sth by separating it into its different parts
senses.chn: 原子论（借助各个组成部分来分析整体）

senses.def: to reduce sth to atoms or very small pieces
senses.chn: 使分裂成原子；使粉碎；使成微粒；使雾化

senses.def: a container that forces a liquid such as water or paint out as a very fine spray
not written in any particular key
immediately; without delay

ex.en: Come here at once!
ex.cn: 马上到这里来！

senses.def: at the same time

ex.en: Don't all speak at once!
ex.cn: 大家不要同时讲！

ex.en: I can't do two things at once.
ex.cn: 我不能同时做两件事。

senses.def: to act in a way that shows you are sorry for doing sth wrong in the past

ex.en: to atone for a crime
ex.cn: 赎罪

senses.def: in one single attempt or try

ex.en: She blew out the candles at one go.
ex.cn: 她一口气把蜡烛全吹灭了。

senses.def: with a single immediate action

ex.en: They threatened to cancel the whole project at a stroke.
ex.cn: 他们威胁要一下子砍掉整个项目。

senses.def: on top of; at the top of

ex.en: a flag high atop a pole
ex.cn: 高挂在旗杆顶端的旗子

ex.en: a scoop of ice cream atop a slice of apple pie
ex.cn: 一片苹果馅饼上面的一勺冰淇淋

senses.def: relating to a form of allergy where there is a reaction in a part of the body that does not have direct contact with the thing causing the allergy
senses.chn: 特应性的，异位的（指过敏部位并非直接接触过敏原）

senses.def: a person that you can rely on to help, protect and comfort you when you are in trouble
senses.chn: （危难时的）可依靠的人，主心骨

senses.def: a book containing street maps of all the areas of a large city
senses.chn: （标明各街道位置的）城市地图册

senses.def: a book containing all the information you need about a subject or place

ex.en: an A to Z of needlework
ex.cn: 女红大全

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'automatic train protection' (a system for automatically stopping a train if the driver does not stop or go slower when a signal tells him/her to)
senses.chn: 列车自动保护系统（全写为 automatic train protection）

senses.def: the connected series of thoughts that are in your head at a particular time

ex.en: The phone ringing interrupted my train of thought.
ex.cn: 电话铃声打断了我的思路。

senses.def: without deciding in advance what is going to happen, or without any regular pattern

ex.en: She opened the book at random (= not at any particular page) and started reading.
ex.cn: 她随意翻开书就看了起来。

ex.en: The terrorists fired into the crowd at random.
ex.cn: 恐怖分子胡乱地向人群开枪。

ex.en: Names were chosen at random from a list.
ex.cn: 名字是从名单中随便点的。

senses.def: extremely well or good

ex.en: His idea worked a treat (= was successful).
ex.cn: 他的主意棒极了。

senses.def: not moving

ex.en: At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.
ex.cn: 这种昆虫不动时看上去像一片枯叶。

senses.def: dead and therefore free from trouble or anxiety. People say 'at rest' to avoid saying 'dead'.
senses.chn: （委婉说法，与 dead 同义）安息，长眠

ex.en: She now lies at rest in the churchyard.
ex.cn: 她现在长眠在教堂墓地里。

senses.def: in danger of being attacked or hurt, especially in their own home
senses.chn: （尤指居家时）处于危险中的，可能遭受伤害的

ex.en: Social services keep lists of at-risk children.
ex.cn: 社工组织保留有在家里可能遭受伤害的孩子名单。

senses.def: a large high space, usually with a glass roof, in the centre of a modern building
senses.chn: （现代建筑物中央通常带有玻璃屋顶的）中庭，中厅

senses.def: an open space in the centre of an ancient Roman villa (= a large house)
either of the two upper spaces in the heart that are used in the first stage of sending the blood around the body
very bad or unpleasant

ex.en: She speaks French with an atrocious accent.
ex.cn: 她讲的法语带有很难听的口音。

ex.en: Isn't the weather atrocious?
ex.cn: 天气不是糟透了吗？

senses.def: very cruel and shocking

ex.en: atrocious acts of brutality
ex.cn: 残暴的兽行

senses.def: a cruel and violent act, especially in a war
the condition of losing flesh, muscle, strength, etc. in a part of the body because it does not have enough blood

ex.en: The cultural life of the country will sink into atrophy unless more writers and artists emerge.
ex.cn: 如果没有更多的作家和艺术家出现，这个国家的文化生活将衰退。

senses.def: if a part of the body atrophies, it becomes weak because it is not used or because it does not have enough blood

ex.en: patients whose muscles have atrophied
ex.cn: 肌萎缩症患者

ex.en: Memory can atrophy through lack of use.
ex.cn: 记忆力不常使用就会衰退。

a trouble shared is a trouble halved.lemma: a trouble shared is a trouble halved

senses.def: if you talk to sb about your problems and worries, instead of keeping them to yourself, they seem less serious
senses.chn: 诉说烦恼，一半自消（向人倾诉，愁苦就会减少）

senses.def: always ready to obey sb's orders

ex.en: Don't expect to have me at your beck and call.
ex.cn: 休想随意摆布我。

senses.def: because sb has ordered or requested it
at a time or a place which is suitable for sb
senses.chn: 在（某人）方便时；在（某人）适宜的地点

ex.en: Can you telephone me at your convenience to arrange a meeting?
ex.cn: 你能不能在你方便时给我来个电话，安排见一次面？

senses.def: according to what sb decides or wishes to do
senses.chn: 由某人斟酌决定；按照某人的意愿

ex.en: Bail is granted at the discretion of the court.
ex.cn: 由法庭决定准予保释。

ex.en: There is no service charge and tipping is at your discretion.
ex.cn: 不收服务费，给不给小费由你自行决定。

senses.def: paid for by sb
senses.chn: 由某人付钱；由某人负担费用

ex.en: We were taken out for a meal at the company's expense.
ex.cn: 公司出钱请我们外出就餐。

senses.def: if you make a joke at sb's expense, you laugh at them and make them feel silly
senses.chn: 在某人受损的情况下；以某人为代价；跟某人开玩笑

senses.def: if you experience sth at the hands of sb, they are the cause of it
senses.chn: 某人导致；出自某人之手

senses.def: completely available for sb to use or to help sb
senses.chn: 随时可供使用（或可以帮助）

ex.en: Health care must be at the service of all who need it.
ex.cn: 医疗保健机构必须为所有需要者提供服务。

ex.en: If you need anything, I am at your service.
ex.cn: 您要是需要什么，请尽管吩咐。

senses.def: on the sea, especially in a ship, or in the sea
senses.chn: 在海上（尤指乘船）；在海里

ex.en: It happened on the second night at sea.
ex.cn: 事情发生在出海后的第二天夜里。

ex.en: They were lost at sea.
ex.cn: 他们在海上迷失了方向。

senses.def: confused and not knowing what to do

ex.en: I'm all at sea with these new regulations.
ex.cn: 我全然不懂这些新的规章。

senses.def: not long in advance; without warning or time for preparation
senses.chn: 随时；一经通知立即；没有准备时间

ex.en: This was the best room we could get at such short notice.
ex.cn: 这是我们临时能弄到的最好的房间了。

ex.en: You must be ready to leave at a moment's notice.
ex.cn: 你必须随时准备出发。

senses.def: in confusion; not well organized
at the place or the point that sth comes from or begins

ex.en: Is your salary taxed at source (= by your employer)?
ex.cn: 你领的是税后工资吗？

senses.def: that can be won or lost, depending on the success of a particular action
senses.chn: 成败难料；得失都可能；有风险

ex.en: We cannot afford to take risks when people's lives are at stake.
ex.cn: 在性命攸关的事情上，不容我们有闪失。

ex.en: The prize at stake is a place in the final.
ex.cn: 这次如果获胜，便能进入决赛。

senses.def: used when you want to encourage sb or show your admiration of them, especially a boy or man
senses.chn: （对男性表示鼓励或钦佩）好样的

senses.def: to fasten or join one thing to another

ex.en: I attach a copy of my notes for your information.
ex.cn: 我附上笔记一份供你参考。

ex.en: I attach a copy of the spreadsheet (= send it with an email).
ex.cn: 我随电子邮件附上电子表格一份。

ex.en: Attach the coupon to the front of your letter.
ex.cn: 把优惠券附在信的正面。

ex.en: They have attached a number of conditions to the agreement (= said that the conditions must be part of the agreement).
ex.cn: 他们在协议上附加了一些条件。

senses.def: to believe that sth is important or worth thinking about
senses.chn: 认为有重要性（或意义、价值、分量等）；重视

ex.en: I attach great importance to this research.
ex.cn: 我认为这项研究十分重要。

senses.def: to join sb for a time, sometimes when you are not welcome or have not been invited
senses.chn: （有时不受欢迎或未受邀请而）参加，和…在一起，缠着

ex.en: He attached himself to me at the party and I couldn't get rid of him.
ex.cn: 在聚会上他老是缠着我，我简直无法摆脱他。

senses.def: to be connected with sb/sth; to connect sth to sth

ex.en: No one is suggesting that any health risks attach to this product.
ex.cn: 没有人指出这个产品可能会危害健康。

ex.en: No blame attaches to you.
ex.cn: 你一点责任也没有。

ex.en: This does not attach any blame to you.
ex.cn: 这事你一点责任也没有。

example.en: I attach a copy of my notes for your information.
example.cn: 我附上笔记一份供你参考。

example.en: Attach the coupon to the front of your letter.
example.cn: 把优惠券附在信的正面。

phrases.pattern: ~ importance, significance, value, weight, etc. (to sth)
phrases.filled: attach importance, significance, value, weight, etc. (to sth)

example.en: No one is suggesting that any health risks attach to this product.
example.cn: 没有人指出这个产品可能会危害健康。

example.en: This does not attach any blame to you.
example.cn: 这事你一点责任也没有。

senses.def: full of affection for sb/sth

ex.en: I've never seen two people so attached to each other.
ex.cn: 我从未见过两个人如此形影不离。

ex.en: We've grown very attached to this house.
ex.cn: 我们变得非常喜欢这座房子。

senses.def: working for or forming part of an organization

ex.en: The research unit is attached to the university.
ex.cn: 这个研究单位附属于大学。

senses.def: joined to sth

ex.en: Please complete the attached application form.
ex.cn: 请填写所附申请表。

senses.def: a strong feeling of affection for sb/sth

ex.en: a child's strong attachment to its parents
ex.cn: 孩子对父母的强烈依恋

senses.def: belief in and support for an idea or a set of values

ex.en: the popular attachment to democratic government
ex.cn: 对民主政府的普遍拥护

senses.def: a tool that you can fix onto a machine, to make it do another job
senses.chn: （机器的）附件，附加装置，附属物

ex.en: an electric drill with a range of different attachments
ex.cn: 配有各种附件的电钻

senses.def: the act of joining one thing to another; a thing that joins two things together

ex.en: All cars built since 1981 have points for the attachment of safety restraints.
ex.cn: 自 1981 年起生产的轿车都有安全保护装置的接口。

ex.en: They discussed the attachment of new conditions to the peace plans.
ex.cn: 他们讨论把新条件加入到和平计划中去。

ex.en: They had to check the strength of the seat attachments to the floor of the plane.
ex.cn: 他们需要检查座椅与飞机舱面连接部位的强度。

senses.def: a short time spent working with an organization such as a hospital, school or part of the armed forces
senses.chn: 暂时隶属于（某医院、学校、部队等）；短期在…工作

ex.en: She's on attachment to the local hospital.
ex.cn: 她暂时在当地医院工作。

ex.en: a 4-month training attachment
ex.cn: 为期 4 个月的培训

senses.def: a document that you send to sb using email
an act of using violence to try to hurt or kill sb

ex.en: a series of racist attacks
ex.cn: 一连串的种族袭击行为

senses.def: an act of trying to kill or injure the enemy in war, using weapons such as guns and bombs
senses.chn: （在战争中使用武器的）进攻，攻击

ex.en: to launch/make/mount an attack
ex.cn: 发起／进行攻击；发动进攻

ex.en: The patrol came under attack from all sides.
ex.cn: 巡逻队受到四面八方的攻击。

senses.def: strong criticism of sb/sth in speech or in writing

ex.en: a scathing attack on the government's policies
ex.cn: 对政府政策的猛烈抨击

ex.en: The school has come under attack for failing to encourage bright pupils.
ex.cn: 这所学校因未能鼓励聪明学生而受到非难。

senses.def: an action that you take to try to stop or change sth that you feel is bad

ex.en: to launch an all-out attack on poverty/unemployment
ex.cn: 全力抑制贫穷／失业

senses.def: a sudden, short period of illness, usually severe, especially an illness that you have often

ex.en: to suffer an asthma attack
ex.cn: 哮喘发作

ex.en: an acute attack of food poisoning
ex.cn: 急性食物中毒

ex.en: a panic attack
ex.cn: 一阵恐慌

ex.en: an attack of the giggles
ex.cn: 一阵咯咯傻笑

senses.def: a sudden period of feeling an emotion such as fear

ex.en: an attack of nerves
ex.cn: 突然紧张不安

senses.def: the action of sth such as an insect, or a disease, that causes damage to sth/sb

ex.en: The roof timbers were affected by rot and insect attack.
ex.cn: 屋顶的木料已经腐朽并遭虫蛀。

senses.def: the players in a team whose job is to try to score goals or points

ex.en: Germany's attack has been weakened by the loss of some key players through injury.
ex.cn: 德国队几名主力队员因伤不能上场，削弱了进攻力量。

senses.def: the actions that players take to try to score a goal or win the game

ex.en: a sustained attack on the Arsenal goal
ex.cn: 向阿森纳队球门的持续进攻

senses.def: to use violence to try to hurt or kill sb

ex.en: Most dogs will not attack unless provoked.
ex.cn: 大多数的狗受到挑衅才会攻击。

ex.en: A woman was attacked and robbed by a gang of youths.
ex.cn: 一名妇女遭到一伙年轻人袭击和抢劫。

ex.en: The man attacked him with a knife.
ex.cn: 那个男人持刀向他行凶。

senses.def: to use weapons, such as guns and bombs against an enemy in a war, etc.
senses.chn: （在战争等中使用武器）进攻，攻击

ex.en: The guerrillas attack at night.
ex.cn: 游击队在夜间发动袭击。

ex.en: At dawn the army attacked the town.
ex.cn: 军队在拂晓时向这座城镇发动攻击。

senses.def: to criticize sb/sth severely

ex.en: a newspaper article attacking the England football manager
ex.cn: 报纸上的一篇抨击英格兰足球队主教练的文章

ex.en: She has been attacked for ignoring her own party members.
ex.cn: 她因漠视本党党员而受到非难。

senses.def: to have a harmful effect on sth

ex.en: a disease that attacks the brain
ex.cn: 侵袭大脑的疾病

ex.en: The vines were attacked by mildew.
ex.cn: 葡萄藤受到了霉菌的侵害。

senses.def: to deal with sth with a lot of energy and determination

ex.en: Let's attack one problem at a time.
ex.cn: 咱们每次全力处理一个问题。

senses.def: to go forward in a game in order to try to score goals or points

ex.en: Spain attacked more in the second half and deserved a goal.
ex.cn: 西班牙队在下半场加强攻势，攻进了一球。

example.en: A woman was attacked and robbed by a gang of youths.
example.cn: 一名妇女遭到一伙年轻人袭击和抢劫。

example.en: The man attacked him with a knife.
example.cn: 那个男人持刀向他行凶。

example.en: At dawn the army attacked the town.
example.cn: 军队在拂晓时向这座城镇发动攻击。

phrases.filled: attack sb/sth for sth/for doing sth

example.en: She has been attacked for ignoring her own party members.
example.cn: 她因漠视本党党员而受到非难。

senses.def: a dog that has been trained to attack people or other animals
a person who often makes strong personal attacks on other people in public
senses.chn: 言辞激烈的人身攻击者；疯狗

ex.en: His image has changed from statesman to attack dog.
ex.cn: 他的形象从政治家变成了见人就咬的恶狗。

senses.def: a person who attacks sb

ex.en: She didn't really see her attacker.
ex.cn: 她没有看清楚袭击她的人。

senses.def: used when you want to encourage a girl or woman, or show your admiration of them
senses.chn: （对女性表示鼓励或钦佩）好样的

senses.def: to succeed in getting sth, usually after a lot of effort

ex.en: Most of our students attained five 'A' grades in their exams.
ex.cn: 我们多数学生的考试成绩是五个优。

senses.def: to reach a particular age, level or condition

ex.en: The cheetah can attain speeds of up to 97 kph.
ex.cn: 猎豹的奔跑速度可达 97 千米每小时。

senses.def: that you can achieve

ex.en: attainable goals/objectives/targets
ex.cn: 可达到的目标

ex.en: This standard is easily attainable by most students.
ex.cn: 这个标准大多数学生都容易达到。

senses.def: something that you achieved

ex.en: a young woman of impressive educational attainments
ex.cn: 一位学业成就斐然的年轻女子

senses.def: success in achieving sth

ex.en: The attainment of his ambitions was still a dream.
ex.cn: 他要实现的抱负仍然是一个梦想。

ex.en: attainment targets (= for example in education)
ex.cn: 学业成绩目标

senses.def: an essential oil usually made from rose petals
senses.chn: （从玫瑰花瓣等中提取的）精油；玫瑰油

senses.def: an act of trying to do sth, especially sth difficult, often with no success

ex.en: I passed my driving test at the first attempt.
ex.cn: 我考汽车驾驶执照时一次就通过了。

ex.en: Two factories were closed in an attempt to cut costs.
ex.cn: 为削减费用，关闭了两家工厂。

ex.en: They made no attempt to escape.
ex.cn: 他们没有企图逃跑。

ex.en: The couple made an unsuccessful attempt at a compromise.
ex.cn: 这对夫妇试图和解但未成功。

senses.def: an act of trying to kill sb

ex.en: Someone has made an attempt on the President's life.
ex.cn: 有人企图刺杀总统。

senses.def: an effort to do better than sth, such as a very good performance in sport

ex.en: his attempt on the world land speed record
ex.cn: 他为创造陆上速度世界纪录所作的尝试

senses.def: to make an effort or try to do sth, especially sth difficult

ex.en: I will attempt to answer all your questions.
ex.cn: 我将努力回答你的全部问题。

ex.en: Do not attempt to repair this yourself.
ex.cn: 不要试图自己修理这个东西。

ex.en: The prisoners attempted an escape, but failed.
ex.cn: 囚犯企图逃跑，但失败了。

example.en: Two factories were closed in an attempt to cut costs.
example.cn: 为削减费用，关闭了两家工厂。

example.en: The couple made an unsuccessful attempt at a compromise.
example.cn: 这对夫妇试图和解但未成功。

example.en: The prisoners attempted an escape, but failed.
example.cn: 囚犯企图逃跑，但失败了。

senses.def: that sb has tried to do but without success

ex.en: attempted rape/murder/robbery
ex.cn: 强奸／谋杀／抢劫未遂

senses.def: to be present at an event

ex.en: We'd like as many people as possible to attend.
ex.cn: 我们希望出席的人越多越好。

ex.en: The meeting was attended by 90% of shareholders.
ex.cn: 90% 的股东出席了会议。

ex.en: to attend a wedding/funeral
ex.cn: 参加婚礼／葬礼

senses.def: to go regularly to a place

ex.en: Our children attend the same school.
ex.cn: 我们的孩子上同一所学校。

ex.en: How many people attend church every Sunday?
ex.cn: 每个星期天有多少人去教堂？

ex.en: Your dentist will ask you to attend for regular check-ups.
ex.cn: 你的牙医会让你定期去检查。

senses.def: to pay attention to what sb is saying or to what you are doing

ex.en: She hadn't been attending during the lesson.
ex.cn: 上课时她一直不专心。

senses.def: to happen at the same time as sth

ex.en: She dislikes the loss of privacy that attends TV celebrity.
ex.cn: 她不喜欢成为电视名人后随之失去个人隐私。

senses.def: to be with sb and help them

ex.en: The President was attended by several members of his staff.
ex.cn: 总统有几名幕僚随从。

senses.def: to deal with sb/sth; to take care of sb/sth

ex.en: I have some urgent business to attend to.
ex.cn: 我有一些急事要处理。

ex.en: A nurse attended to his needs constantly.
ex.cn: 有一位护士经常照料他的需要。

ex.en: Are you being attended to, Sir?(= for example, in a shop)
ex.cn: 先生，有人接待你吗？

example.en: The meeting was attended by 90% of shareholders.
example.cn: 90% 的股东出席了会议。

senses.def: the act of being present at a place, for example at school

ex.en: Attendance at these lectures is not compulsory.
ex.cn: 这些课不是硬性规定要听的。

ex.en: Teachers must keep a record of students' attendances.
ex.cn: 老师必须记录学生的出勤情况。

senses.def: the number of people present at an organized event

ex.en: high/low/falling/poor attendances
ex.cn: 出席的人数多／少／下降／很少

ex.en: There was an attendance of 42 at the meeting.
ex.cn: 有 42 人参加了会议。

senses.def: to be present at a special event

ex.en: Several heads of state were in attendance at the funeral.
ex.cn: 有几位国家元首出席了葬礼。

senses.def: to be with or near sb in order to help them if necessary
senses.chn: 陪侍；随侍（某人）左右；服侍

ex.en: He always has at least two bodyguards in attendance.
ex.cn: 他总有至少两名保镖护卫。

ex.en: As you're aware, this is not a new problem.
ex.cn: 正如你所了解的，这不是一个新问题。

ex.en: As far as I'm aware, nobody has done anything about it.
ex.cn: 据我所知，尚无人对此采取任何措施。

ex.en: acutely/painfully (= very) aware
ex.cn: 深切地／痛苦地认识到

ex.en: I don't think people are really aware of just how much it costs.
ex.cn: 我认为人们并不真正明白这要花多少钱。

ex.en: He was well aware of the problem.
ex.cn: 他很清楚这个问题。

ex.en: Everybody should be made aware of the risks involved.
ex.cn: 应该让人人都知道所涉及的风险。

senses.def: noticing that sth is present, or that sth is happening

ex.en: She slipped away without him being aware of it.
ex.cn: 她悄悄离开，没有让他发觉。

ex.en: They suddenly became aware of people looking at them.
ex.cn: 他们突然意识到有些人在瞧着他们。

ex.en: I was aware that she was trembling.
ex.cn: 我察觉到她在发抖。

senses.def: interested in and knowing about sth, and thinking it is important

ex.en: Young people are very environmentally aware.
ex.cn: 年轻人的环保意识很强。

example.en: I don't think people are really aware of just how much it costs.
example.cn: 我认为人们并不真正明白这要花多少钱。

example.en: Were you aware that something was wrong?
example.cn: 你有没有意识到已经出了问题？

example.en: She slipped away without him being aware of it.
example.cn: 她悄悄离开，没有让他发觉。

senses.def: knowing sth; knowing that sth exists and is important; being interested in sth

ex.en: an awareness of the importance of eating a healthy diet
ex.cn: 对健康饮食重要性的认识

ex.en: There was an almost complete lack of awareness of the issues involved.
ex.cn: 对有关问题几乎是一无所知。

ex.en: It is important that students develop an awareness of how the Internet can be used.
ex.cn: 重要的是学生逐渐懂得如何使用互联网。

ex.en: to raise/heighten/increase public awareness of sth
ex.cn: 加强／提高／增强公众对某事物的意识

ex.en: a greater/a growing/an increasing awareness of sth
ex.cn: 对某事物更大的／日益增长的／愈来愈大的兴趣

ex.en: environmental awareness (= knowing that looking after the environment is important)
ex.cn: 环境意识

senses.def: an attempt to defeat your opponents by putting pressure on them so that they lose courage or confidence
senses.chn: 神经战（利用心理压力摧毁对方的斗志）

senses.def: a bitter argument or disagreement over a period of time between two or more people or groups

ex.en: the political war of words over tax
ex.cn: 有关税收问题的政治论战

senses.def: covered with water
senses.chn: 被淹没；被漫过；被水覆盖

senses.def: having sth in large quantities

ex.en: The city is awash with drugs.
ex.cn: 这座城市毒品泛滥。

senses.def: a person who is useless or no good at anything
senses.chn: 无用的人；干什么都不行的人；废物；饭桶

senses.def: used to say that when you are impatient for sth to happen, time seems to pass very slowly
senses.chn: 心急水不开（越心急，时间过得越慢）

senses.def: to or at a distance from sb/sth in space or time
senses.chn: （时间或空间上）离开（某距离），在（某距离）处

ex.en: The beach is a mile away.
ex.cn: 海滩在一英里外。

ex.en: Christmas is still months away.
ex.cn: 离圣诞节还有几个月。

ex.en: The station is a few minutes' walk away from here.
ex.cn: 车站离这里有步行几分钟的路程。

senses.def: to a different place or in a different direction

ex.en: Go away!
ex.cn: 走开！

ex.en: Put your toys away.
ex.cn: 把你的玩具收拾起来。

ex.en: The bright light made her look away.
ex.cn: 强光使她把视线转向别处。

senses.def: not present

ex.en: There were ten children away yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天有十个孩子缺席。

ex.en: Sorry, he's away.
ex.cn: 对不起，他不在。

ex.en: She was away from work for a week.
ex.cn: 她有一个星期没来上班。

senses.def: used after verbs to say that sth is done continuously or with a lot of energy
senses.chn: （用于动词后）持续地，劲头十足地

ex.en: She was still writing away furiously when the bell went.
ex.cn: 铃声响时她还在不停地写着。

ex.en: They were soon chatting away like old friends.
ex.cn: 他们很快就像老朋友一样聊起天来。

senses.def: until disappearing completely

ex.en: The water boiled away.
ex.cn: 水烧干了。

ex.en: The music faded away.
ex.cn: 乐声逐渐消失。

ex.en: They danced the night away (= all night).
ex.cn: 他们跳舞跳了一个通宵。

senses.def: at the opponent's ground or stadium

ex.en: Chelsea are playing away this Saturday.
ex.cn: 本周六切尔西队要在客场比赛。

ex.en: an away match/game
ex.cn: 客场比赛

senses.def: used to say that you would like to be rid of sb/sth

ex.en: Away with all these rules and regulations!
ex.cn: 让所有这些规章制度见鬼去吧！

senses.def: to help sb start sth in a fresh, lively state of mind
senses.chn: 使头脑清醒；使振作精神

ex.en: A brisk walk should blow the cobwebs away.
ex.cn: 轻快的散步可以使人头脑清醒。

senses.def: to dance for the whole evening or night
by a very great amount

ex.en: She's far and away the best player.
ex.cn: 她是当之无愧的最佳选手。

senses.def: immediately; without delay

ex.en: I want it sent right away.
ex.cn: 马上把它发出去。

ex.en: I told him right off what I thought of him.
ex.cn: 我直截了当地告诉了他我对他的看法。

senses.def: immediately; without delay

ex.en: I'll do it straight away.
ex.cn: 这件事我马上就做。

example.en: The station is a few minutes' walk away from here.
example.cn: 车站离这里有步行几分钟的路程。

senses.def: a day that a group of workers spend together away from their usual place of work in order to discuss ideas or plans
senses.chn: （不在工作场所的）外出研讨日

ex.en: The management are having an awayday to discuss strategy.
ex.cn: 管理层今天外出商议策略。

ex.en: We talked about it at the awayday.
ex.cn: 我们外出开会那天说起过这事。

senses.def: away from a person's own house, flat/apartment, etc.

ex.en: He works away from home during the week.
ex.cn: 他除了周末都在外工作。

ex.en: I don't want to be away from home for too long.
ex.cn: 我不想离家时间太长。

senses.def: if a sports team plays away from home, it plays in the town, etc. that its opponent comes from
something that allows you to join a group of people, an industry, etc. that it is difficult to join, or to understand sth that it is difficult to understand
senses.chn: （加入难以进入的群体、行业等的）敲门砖；（弄懂难以理解的事物的）窍门，诀窍

senses.def: feelings of respect and slight fear; feelings of being very impressed by sth/sb

ex.en: awe and respect
ex.cn: 敬畏和尊敬

ex.en: awe and wonder
ex.cn: 敬畏和惊奇

ex.en: He speaks of her with awe.
ex.cn: 他谈到她时肃然起敬。

ex.en: 'It's magnificent,' she whispered in awe.
ex.cn: “真是壮丽。” 她小声地惊叹道。

senses.def: to admire sb/sth and be slightly frightened of them/it

ex.en: While Diana was in awe of her grandfather, she adored her grandmother.
ex.cn: 黛安娜敬畏她的祖父，但深爱她的祖母。

senses.def: to fill sb with awe

ex.en: She seemed awed by the presence of so many famous people.
ex.cn: 见到这么多名人出席，似乎令她惊叹不已。

senses.def: impressive; making you feel respect and admiration
senses.chn: 令人惊叹的；使人敬佩的；令人敬慕的

ex.en: The building was awe-inspiring in size and design.
ex.cn: 这座建筑的规模和设计气势宏伟。

senses.def: very impressive or very difficult and perhaps rather frightening
senses.chn: 令人惊叹的；使人惊惧的；很困难的；难得吓人的

ex.en: an awesome sight
ex.cn: 惊人的奇观

ex.en: awesome beauty/power
ex.cn: 天仙之美；惊人能量

ex.en: They had an awesome task ahead.
ex.cn: 他们面前有十分艰巨的任务。

senses.def: very good, enjoyable, etc.

ex.en: I just bought this awesome new CD!
ex.cn: 我刚买了这张特棒的新 CD！

ex.en: Wow! That's totally awesome!
ex.cn: 哇！真是棒极了！

ex.en: We had a great time in Madrid.
ex.cn: 我们在马德里玩得很开心。

ex.en: I think their new song's really cool.
ex.cn: 我认为他们的新歌棒极了。

ex.en: 'How was your holiday?' 'Fantastic!'
ex.cn: “你假期过得好吗？” “棒极了！”

ex.en: Jane's a fabulous cook.
ex.cn: 简的烹饪技巧堪称一绝。

senses.def: feeling very impressed by sth

ex.en: People were awestruck by the pictures the satellite sent back to Earth.
ex.cn: 人们对人造卫星传送回地球的图片叹为观止。

senses.def: very bad or unpleasant

ex.en: That's an awful colour.
ex.cn: 那颜色难看得很。

ex.en: 'They didn't even offer to pay.' 'Oh that's awful.'
ex.cn: “他们甚至不主动付钱。” “哦，那真不像话。”

ex.en: It's awful, isn't it?
ex.cn: 糟糕透了，不是吗？

ex.en: The weather last summer was awful.
ex.cn: 刚过去的夏季天气真坏。

ex.en: I feel awful about forgetting her birthday.
ex.cn: 我忘了她的生日，感到很过意不去。

ex.en: to look/feel awful (= to look/feel ill)
ex.cn: 面带病容；感到很不舒服

senses.def: used to emphasize sth, especially that there is a large amount or too much of sth

ex.en: It's going to cost an awful lot of money.
ex.cn: 这要花非常多的钱。

ex.en: There's not an awful lot of room.
ex.cn: 没有很多的空间。

ex.en: I feel an awful lot better than I did yesterday.
ex.cn: 我觉得身体比昨天好得多了。

ex.en: I had an awful job persuading him to come (= it was very difficult).
ex.cn: 说服他来真是费劲死了。

senses.def: very shocking

ex.en: the awful horrors of war
ex.cn: 骇人听闻的战争恐怖情形

senses.def: very; extremely

ex.en: Clint is awful smart.
ex.cn: 克林特机灵极了。

senses.def: very; extremely

ex.en: I'm awfully sorry about that problem the other day.
ex.cn: 我对前几天的那个问题感到非常遗憾。

senses.def: for a short time
very much; a lot

ex.en: I'm feeling a whole lot better.
ex.cn: 我觉得好得多了。

senses.def: making you feel embarrassed
senses.chn: 令人尴尬的；使人难堪的

ex.en: There was an awkward silence.
ex.cn: 一阵令人尴尬的沉默。

senses.def: difficult to deal with

ex.en: Don't ask awkward questions.
ex.cn: 不要问难答的问题。

ex.en: You've put me in an awkward position.
ex.cn: 你使得我狼狈不堪。

ex.en: an awkward customer (= a person who is difficult to deal with)
ex.cn: 难对付的家伙

ex.en: Please don't be awkward about letting him come.
ex.cn: 关于让他来这事请你不要作梗。

senses.def: not convenient

ex.en: Have I come at an awkward time?
ex.cn: 我来得不是时候吧？

senses.def: difficult or dangerous because of its shape or design
senses.chn: （因形状、设计而）产生困难的，危险的

ex.en: This box is very awkward for one person to carry.
ex.cn: 这只箱子一个人很不好搬。

senses.def: not moving in an easy way; not comfortable

ex.en: He tried to dance, but he was too clumsy and awkward.
ex.cn: 他试着跳舞，但是太笨拙，太别扭。

ex.en: I must have slept in an awkward position—I'm aching all over.
ex.cn: 我肯定是睡姿不当，搞得全身疼痛。

senses.def: a small pointed tool used for making holes, especially in leather
a sheet of strong cloth that stretches out from above a door or window to keep off the sun or rain
absent without leave (used especially in the armed forces when sb has left their group without permission)
senses.chn: 擅离职守，无故离队，开小差（尤用于军队）

ex.en: He's gone AWOL from his base.
ex.cn: 他从基地开了小差。

ex.en: The guitarist went AWOL in the middle of the recording.
ex.cn: 在录音过程当中吉他手溜走了。

senses.def: a person who seems to be friendly or harmless but is really an enemy
if sth goes awry, it does not happen in the way that was planned.

ex.en: All my plans for the party had gone awry.
ex.cn: 我的聚会计划全乱了套。

senses.def: not in the right position

ex.en: She rushed out, her hair awry.
ex.cn: 她披头散发冲了出来。

senses.def: a tool with a wooden handle and a heavy metal blade, used for chopping wood, cutting down trees, etc.
if sb gets the axe, they lose their job; if an institution or a project gets the axe, it is closed or stopped, usually because of a lack of money

ex.en: Up to 300 workers are facing the axe at a struggling Merseyside firm.
ex.cn: 默西赛德的一家艰苦挣扎的公司有多达 300 名工人面临被解雇。

ex.en: Patients are delighted their local hospital has been saved from the axe.
ex.cn: 病人高兴的是当地医院得以免遭关闭。

senses.def: to have private reasons for being involved in sth or for arguing for a particular cause

ex.en: She had no axe to grind and was only acting out of concern for their safety.
ex.cn: 她毫无私心，这样做只是出于对他们安全的担忧。

senses.def: to get rid of a service, system, etc. or to reduce the money spent on it by a large amount
senses.chn: 精简（机构等）；大量削减（经费等）

ex.en: Other less profitable services are to be axed later this year.
ex.cn: 其他盈利较少的服务预计今年稍晚将被大量削减。

senses.def: to remove sb from their job

ex.en: Jones has been axed from the team.
ex.cn: 琼斯已被开除出队。

senses.def: to kill sb with an axe
a jump in skating in which you jump from the front outside edge of one foot, turn in the air, and land on the outside edge of your other foot
senses.chn: 阿克塞尔跳，前外跳（滑冰运动中以一脚前外刃起跳空中旋转后以另一脚外刃落冰）

senses.def: a man who attacks other people with an axe
of or related to an axis

ex.en: an axial road
ex.cn: 轴路

senses.def: a rule or principle that most people believe to be true
true in such an obvious way that you do not need to prove it

ex.en: It is axiomatic that life is not always easy.
ex.cn: 生活并不总是一帆风顺，这是明摆着的事实。

senses.def: an imaginary line through the centre of an object, around which the object turns
senses.chn: 轴（旋转物体假想的中心线）

ex.en: Mars takes longer to revolve on its axis than the Earth.
ex.cn: 火星自转一周的时间比地球长。

senses.def: a fixed line against which the positions of points are measured, especially points on a graph

ex.en: the vertical/horizontal axis
ex.cn: 纵／横坐标轴

senses.def: a line that divides a shape into two equal parts
senses.chn: 对称中心线（将物体平分为二）

ex.en: an axis of symmetry
ex.cn: 对称轴

ex.en: The axis of a circle is its diameter.
ex.cn: 圆的对称中心线就是其直径。

senses.def: an agreement or alliance between two or more countries
senses.chn: 轴心（国与国之间的协议或联盟）

ex.en: the Franco-German axis
ex.cn: 法德轴心

senses.def: a long straight piece of metal that connects a pair of wheels on a vehicle

ex.en: the front/rear axle
ex.cn: 前／后车轴

senses.def: the long thin part of a nerve cell along which signals are sent to other cells
senses.chn: 轴突（神经细胞长的突起，将信号传递到其他细胞）

senses.def: a woman whose job is caring for children, doing domestic work, etc.
senses.chn: （照看孩子、做家务等的）女佣，阿嬷

senses.def: a person whose job is caring for sb who is ill/sick
senses.chn: （照料病人的）护理员，看护人员

senses.def: a religious leader of Shiite Muslims in Iran
senses.chn: 阿亚图拉（伊朗伊斯兰教什叶派宗教领袖）

senses.def: yes

ex.en: 'Did you see what happened?' 'Oh aye, I was there.'
ex.cn: “你看见了发生的事吗？” “啊，是的，我在场。”

senses.def: always; still
the total number of people voting 'yes' in a formal debate, for example in a parliament
senses.chn: （议会等辩论中的）赞成票总数

ex.en: The ayes have it (= more people have voted for sth than against it).
ex.cn: 投票赞成的人占多数。

senses.def: a port in south-west Scotland, on the Firth of Clyde
senses.chn: 艾尔（苏格兰西南部港口，位于克莱德湾沿岸）

senses.def: a type of traditional Hindu medicine that treats illnesses using a combination of foods, herbs and breathing exercises
senses.chn: 阿育吠陀医学（结合食物、草药和呼吸运动治疗疾病的印度教传统医学）

senses.def: a plant or bush with large flowers that may be pink, purple, white or yellow, grown in a pot or in a garden
a country in south-eastern Europe
(a person) from Azerbaijan
senses.chn: 阿塞拜疆人；阿塞拜疆的；阿塞拜疆人的

senses.def: (a person) from Azerbaijan, or a member of the Azeri people
senses.chn: 阿塞拜疆（族）人；阿塞拜疆的；阿塞拜疆（族）人的

senses.def: an angle related to a distance around the earth's horizon, used to find out the position of a star, planet, etc.
senses.chn: 方位角，地平经度（用以找出恒星、行星等的方位）

senses.def: bright blue in colour like the sky
